blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Background and Objective: Our main goal is ultrasound guidance: moving a probe until its image matches a target view. Published methods for each part of a guide are evaluated in separate simulators. We asked whether these methods, combined into one guide, are good enough.
  Methods: We built USB Gym, a testbed whose standard engine simulates ultrasound from public patient CT, with a network drawing organ textures from CT labels. Its guide has three replaceable parts (slots), an organ segmenter, a controller and a reward, which received 20 published methods, each run on the same 60 episodes of six held-out patients. In each slot, a published method replaced ours only if detectably better on these patients. The better of this combination and our original guide on 20 new CTs is the benchmark baseline. A pose oracle, reading the exact probe pose available only in simulation, set the reference. The results below are exploratory.
  Results: On these CTs, the probe started on average 16.0 mm from the target view; the pose oracle brought it to 1.5 mm. Of the results known when the combination was fixed, only an image-similarity reward (SSIM) was slightly but detectably better, so the combination was our guide with that reward. This combination was the benchmark baseline, ending at 13.7 mm (16% of the oracle's progress).
  Conclusions: Combining untuned published methods with ours did not guide the probe near the target view; the task remains under-explored. The testbed accepts new methods; no guide was tested on hardware.
blocks.zh:
背景和目标: 我们的主要目标是超声波引导:移动探测器直到其图像与目标视图匹配. 指南每一部分的公布方法在单独的模拟器中进行评估。 我们问这些方法合并为一个指南是否足够。
方法: 我们建造了USB Gym,一个测试台,其标准引擎模拟来自公众病人CT的超声波,其网络绘制器官纹理来自CT标签. 其指南有3个可替换的部分(片段),1个器官分割器,1个控制器和1个奖赏,获得20种公布的方法,每集运行在相同60集的6个被搁置的病人身上. 在每一个插槽中,一种公布的方法 只有在这些病人身上检测得更好时 才能取代我们的方法。 这种组合和我们在20个新的CT上的原始指南越好,就是基准基线. 一个姿势甲骨文,读取精确的探测器 仅用于模拟,设置了参考。 下文是探讨的结果。
结果: 在这些CT上,探测器平均从目标视野开始16.0毫米;姿势甲骨文使其达到1.5毫米. 在固定组合时已知的结果中,只有图像-相似性奖励(SSIM)略微但可察觉地更好,所以组合就是我们以此奖励的指南. 这一组合是基准基线,以13.7毫米(甲骨文进步的16%)结束.
结论:将未调整的公布方法与我们的方法相结合,并没有指导目标视图附近的探测器;任务仍未得到充分探索。 测试台接受新方法;没有在硬件上测试向导.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Our main goal is ultrasound guidance for view matching: a closed loop that moves a probe until its image matches a target view.
Such a guide combines several parts, among them a probe-navigation policy, an ultrasound segmenter and, in simulation, a B-mode renderer, but the groups that propose them rarely share a closed loop in which to compare them [ 1 ] .
Without a shared loop, their errors on view matching share no scale.
blocks.zh:
我们的主要目标是超声波对视比的引导:一个闭环,将探测器移动到其图像与目标视图匹配为止.
这种指南结合了多个部分,其中包括探针导航政策,超声波分解器,在模拟中还有B-模度渲染器,但提出它们的组别很少共享一个闭路圈来比较它们[1].
没有共享的环路,他们在视图匹配上的错误共享没有尺度 。

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, no public testbed lets published methods replace any of several loop components and be evaluated against a privileged oracle ladder on identical episodes.
We therefore asked whether existing published components, combined into one guide, are good enough for this task, and built a testbed into which research components plug and are scored.
Here, a guide is good enough, and solves the task, if it ends as close to the target as the privileged pose oracle without privileged input at run time; we report how far each pipeline remains from it.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,没有任何公共测试台允许公布的方法取代几个循环组件,并在相同的剧集中根据特权的甲骨文阶梯进行评价。
因此,我们询问,现有的出版部分合并成一个指南,是否足以完成这项任务,并建立了一个试验台,使研究部分插上并打分。
在这里,一个指南就足够了,并且解决了这个任务,如果它结束于目标,就像特权的姿势甲骨文一样,在运行时没有特权的投入;我们报告每个管道离它还有多远。

blocks.en:
USB Gym (UltraSound B-mode Gym) is that testbed, built on Gymnasium [ 2 ] and patient CT [ 3 ] .
Its standard simulation engine renders patient CT with a physics renderer and the SonoSPADE texture stage, and its guide has three plug slots: mask source, controller and reward (Fig. 1 , Table 2 ). We plugged 20 published methods into the guide’s slots, each in place of its slot’s reference component, on that component’s 60 held-out episodes; seven more, in the engine’s three slots, are in B .
An oracle ladder runs from a pose oracle, which reads privileged simulator state that no physical rig provides, down to a static probe (Section 5.2 ).
SonoSPADE [ 4 ] , our published method, is the engine’s texture stage, unchanged and retrained once.
blocks.zh:
美国B  G(英語:UltraSound B-mode Gym)是试验床,建于y[2]和病人CT[3]上.
其标准模拟引擎使患者CT具有物理渲染器和SonoSPADE纹理级,其导师有三个插槽:面具源,控制器和奖励(图1,表2). 我们在指南的插槽中插入了20种已公布的方法,每个插槽代替其插槽的参考部分,关于该插槽的60个插槽;在发动机的三个插槽中,还有7个插槽在B。
甲骨文阶梯从一个姿势甲骨文,它读作特权模拟器状态,即没有物理钻机提供,到静态探测器(第5.2节)。
SonoSPADE [4],我们公布的方法,是发动机的纹理阶段,一次不变和再训练.

blocks.en:
Here, existing published components, untuned, do not close the gap to the pose oracle, whether plugged one slot at a time or combined with our published pipeline [ 5 ] (Section 7.4 ).
From a 16.0 mm start on six held-out patients, the pose oracle ends at 1.5 mm, but the CT-mask servo, steering by the CT’s true organ masks (privileged CT masks), ends at 11.6 to 11.8 mm.
No published controller in place of ours, given the same input, ends detectably closer (exploratory).
Steering by a segmenter’s masks, the learned-mask servo ends above the start with the ladder’s three other texture settings.
With SonoSPADE, the standard stage and the only one reading the CT label, it ends at 13.1 mm, 3.4 to 3.8 mm closer than with any of them.
blocks.zh:
这里,现有的已公布的组件,未经调试,不会与姿势甲骨文拉近差距,无论是一次插入一个插槽,还是与我们已公布的管道[5]相结合(第7.4节).
从16.0毫米开始对6名被搁置的病人,姿势甲骨文以1.5毫米结束,但由CT真器官口罩(priviled CT口罩)指导的CT-mask servo则以11.6毫米至11.8毫米结束.
在同一输入下,没有公布的控制器取代我们的控制器,结束可探测的更接近(探索性).
由分机的口罩指导, 学习的掩体服务器在起始点上方以阶梯的其他三个纹理设置结束 。
与SonoSPADE,标准级和唯一一个读取CT标签的版本,其终点为13.1毫米,3.4至3.8毫米比其中任何一个接近.

blocks.en:
The contributions are: 1. A closed-loop testbed on patient CT (Sections 3 to 6 ), with privileged state kept out of the policy’s observation. 2. A slot-by-slot reference set for the guide (Section 7 ): every method’s error on the standard engine, paired with its slot’s reference component. 3. Controls and replication (Section 8 ): a positive control, label-input controls, an offline real-frame score and two replication cohorts in simulation. 4. A benchmark baseline (Box 1 ; Section 7.4 ): to test the testbed, slot components chosen on six held-out patients are combined and tested on 20 new CTs (exploratory).
On the standard engine, it is that combination, 13.70 mm from the target (pose oracle 1.47 mm; conditional on this renderer).
blocks.zh:
捐款如下: 1. 对病人CT进行闭路试验(第3至6节),而特殊状态则不受政策观察。 2. 指南(第7节)的分档参考集:标准发动机上每种方法的错误,与其分档参考部分对齐。 3. 控制与复制(第8节):正面控制、标签输入控制、离线实框分数和模拟中的两个复制组。 4. 基准基线(框1;第7.4节):为了测试试验床,对6名被搁置病人选择的槽组件进行合并,对20个新的CT(试验)进行测试。
在标准发动机上,是离目标13.70毫米的组合(有甲骨文1.47毫米;条件是这个渲染器).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Ultrasound simulation. Ultrasound simulators turn labeled anatomy into B-mode frames for a probe pose, from CT on a GPU [ 6 ] , by convolutional ray tracing of a labeled CT volume [ 7 ] or by simulating the acoustic field, as Field II [ 8 ] , k-Wave [ 9 ] and SIMUS [ 10 , 11 ] do; they leave the closed loop to the user.
USB Gym’s renderer slot runs SIMUS and the original code of LOTUS, which learns such a ray model jointly with a segmentation task [ 12 ] ( B.5 ).
blocks.zh:
超声模拟. 超声模拟器将标注的解剖学变成B-模度框架,用于探测器姿势,从GPU上的CT[6],通过对标注的CT卷[7]的演化射线跟踪,或通过模拟声场,如Field II[8],k-Wave[9]和SIMUS[10,11];它们将闭环留给用户.
美国B Gym的渲染器槽运行了SIMUS和LOTUS的原始代码,它们学习这种射线模型与分区任务[12](B.5.

blocks.en:
Learned texture. Learned texture stages move simulated frames toward real-scan appearance, and USB Gym’s texture slot accepts one.
CACTUSS translates real B-mode images into an intermediate representation rendered from CT labels [ 13 ] .
Vitale et al. added CycleGAN texture to ray-traced abdominal simulations [ 14 , 15 ] , and SonoSPADE, from our group, conditions texture on a tissue label map [ 16 , 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
学习的纹理。 了解的纹理阶段将模拟帧移向真实扫描的外观,USB Gym的纹理槽接受一个.
CACTUSS将真实的B-mode图像转换成由CT标签提供的中间代表[13].
Vitale等人增加了周期 GAN纹理到射线跟踪腹部模拟[14,15],以及来自我们组的SonoSPADE,组织标签图上的纹理条件[16,4].

blocks.en:
Learning probe navigation. Learned probe-navigation methods, reviewed in two surveys [ 1 , 17 ] , are each trained and evaluated in their own environment.
Some learn from recorded scans: Droste et al. predicted probe motions offline from 464 tracked clinical scans [ 18 ] , and Li et al. steered a virtual probe through 41 reconstructed spine volumes, rewarded by its distance to a goal pose [ 19 ] .
Others train on simulated images: Amadou et al. trained goal-conditioned agents on images path-traced offline from 929 patient CTs [ 20 ] .
Hu et al. trained a deep Q-network on CT reslices synthesized into ultrasound by Field II, CycleGAN or U-GAT-IT [ 21 ] , and their later agent, rewarded by CT labels, reached 75.8% success on a phantom and 74.0% on a cadaver [ 22 ] .
Han et al. imitated a virtual expert that reads the true pose, in a ray-casting simulator with a CUT texture stage on MRI label maps [ 23 ] .
Qian et al. compared nine image generators behind one SAC policy [ 24 ] ; one of their policies, trained only in simulation, succeeded in 390 of 400 zero-shot deployments on a robot over a phantom.
As of October 2026, we found no runnable environment released with these seven method papers.
blocks.zh:
学习探针导航. 在两次调查[1、17]中审查的已学到的探险导航方法,每一次都在各自环境中接受训练和评价。
有些人从记录的扫描中得知: 德罗斯特等. (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). Expected protection offline from 464 履带式临床扫描[18],以及李等人. 通过41个重建的脊椎体积 引导一个虚拟探测器 用它距离一个目标来回报
其他训练模拟图像: 阿马杜等. 929位患者CTs[20]的图像路径追踪断线上训练有门的特工.
胡等编著. 在CT重现器上训练了深Q网络,由Field II, CycleGAN或U-GAT-IT合成成超声波[21],他们后来的代理人,得到CT标签的奖励,在幽灵上取得了75.8%的成功,在尸体上取得了74.0%的成功[22].
韩等. 模仿了读取真实姿势的虚拟专家,在核磁共振标签地图上带有CUT纹理舞台的射线模拟器[23].
Q等. 比较一个SAC政策背后的9个图像生成器 [24]; 他们的政策之一,只受过模拟训练,成功在机器人上进行了400次零镜头部署中的390次,超过了幻影.
截至2026年10月,我们发现没有随这七份方法文件一起释放的可循环环境.

blocks.en:
Visual servoing. Ultrasound visual servoing maps image features to probe velocity: Mebarki et al. controlled six degrees of freedom from organ image moments [ 25 ] , and Krupa et al. used speckle to stabilize a B-mode view against tissue motion [ 26 ] .
USB Gym’s reference controller starts from such a map: its servo base, an image servo, fits the map by least squares rather than deriving it (Box 1 ).
blocks.zh:
视觉服务. 超声波视觉伺服图 图像特性以探测速度 : 梅巴尔基等人著. 控制了六度自由度的器官图像瞬间[25],以及Krupa等人. 使用Speekle来稳定B-mode对组织运动的视线[26].
美国B Gym的参考控制器起源于这样的地图:它的伺服器基础,一个图像伺服器,用最小的方块来匹配地图,而不是从中衍生出来(Box 1 ).

blocks.en:
Runnable testbeds. Simulation testbeds let robot-learning groups evaluate methods in one fixed environment.
Table 1 lists the ultrasound environments that a researcher can run and plug a method into.
Hase et al. released a Gym environment and its data, frames recorded from 34 volunteers [ 27 ] .
VesNet-RL released an environment of simulated binary vessel images [ 28 ] .
Its agent segments real images into such masks before acting.
SonoGym brings such testbeds to robotic ultrasound on NVIDIA Isaac Lab, with orthopedic navigation, bone-surface reconstruction and spinal surgery tasks [ 29 , 30 ] , and renders CT anatomy by ray tracing or with the paired translator pix2pix [ 29 , 31 ] .
NVIDIA’s Isaac for Healthcare adds ultrasound robot workflows and a ray-traced ultrasound sensor on Isaac Sim [ 32 ] .
USB Gym builds on Gym, Gymnasium and MuJoCo [ 33 , 2 , 34 ] , and its privileged channel lets an imitation teacher see state that the policy cannot, as in Learning by Cheating [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh:
可运行测试床。 模拟测试床让机器人学习团体在一个固定环境中评价方法.
表1列出了研究者可以运行并插入一种方法的超声波环境.
Hase 等人著. 发布了一个健身环境及其数据,由34名志愿者录制的框架[27].
VesNet-RL发布了模拟二进制容器图像的环境[28].
它的代理在行动前把真实的图像分解成这样的面具.
SonoGym给NVIDIA Isaac Lab上的机器人超声波带来了这样的测试床,带有矫形导航,骨面重建以及脊椎手术任务[29,30],并通过射线跟踪或与配对的翻译pix2pix[29,31]使CT解剖学.
NVIDIA的"Isaac for Health Care"增加了超声波机器人工作流程和Isaac Sim上的射线跟踪超声波传感器[32].
美国B Gym以Gym,Gymnasium和MuJoCo[33,2,34]为基础,其特权频道让一位模仿老师看到,政策不能,如在"学习骗局"[35].

blocks.en: 3 USB Gym: testbed design
blocks.zh: 3 USB Gym:试验台设计

blocks.en: Figure 1 : The USB Gym closed loop. Each step slices the patient’s labeled CT at the probe pose, renders a frame and applies a texture stage. A mask source labels the organs of the observation and the target frame. The controller’s twist moves the probe, a lagged position servo, against a contact plane through the target window face. This target-anchored contact and the start lift onto it are privileged structure ( † , red dashed arrow). Shaded boxes are the six plug slots, and white boxes with a heavy outline are configured components (Table 2 ). The dashed privileged channel feeds evaluation code and imitation teachers only.
blocks.zh: 图1:USB Gym闭环. 每一步在探测器姿势上切片给病人贴上标签的CT,制作一个帧并应用一个纹理阶段. 口罩源给观察的器官和靶框贴上标签. 控制器的扭矩通过目标窗口面对接触平面移动探测器,一个落后位置的伺服器. 这种目标悬浮的接触和启动升降机是特殊结构(QQ,红色破碎箭头)。 阴影箱是6个插槽,带有重轮廓的白色箱是配置组件(表2 ). 破败的特权频道只提供评价代码和模仿教师.

blocks.en: 3.1 Design goals, loop and task
blocks.zh: 3.1 设计目标、循环和任务

blocks.en:
USB Gym keeps every component of a closed ultrasound loop fixed except the one a user replaces, so a change in final error can be traced to that component.
In each step (Fig. 1 ), the pose selects a CT label slice, which the simulation engine, a renderer and a texture stage, turns into the observation.
A mask source labels the organs of the observation and target for the reward to score.
The controller outputs a twist, a velocity of three translations and three rotations, which MuJoCo [ 34 ] executes against contact.
blocks.zh:
美国B Gym保留了闭合超声圈的每个组件固定,除了一个用户替换的一个,所以最终错误的变化可以追溯到这个组件.
在每一步(图1)中,姿势会选择一个CT标签切片,模拟引擎,渲染器和纹理级会转化为观测.
口罩源给观察的器官和奖励目标贴上标签,以便得分.
控制器输出一个扭矩,三个翻译和三个旋转的速度,MujoCo[34]针对联系执行.

blocks.en:
The task is a Gymnasium [ 2 ] environment in which the probe moves from a perturbed start to match a target view.
An acoustic window is a skin pose from which the beam reaches the target organ largely free of bone, lung and bowel gas.
Each target is the view at a screened liver or kidney window.
Its start is drawn uniformly within ± 20 \pm 20 mm lateral and elevational, ± 10 \pm 10 mm axial, ± 18 ∘ \pm 18^{\circ} of tilt and ± 4 ∘ \pm 4^{\circ} of roll.
Each step commands at most 3 mm along and 0.05 rad about each axis.
The observation contains the last four 128 × 128 128\times 128 frames, the target frame and optional organ masks.
Episodes have no terminal state and are truncated at 12 steps.
The task is therefore local re-acquisition near a known window: finding a window from afar and deciding when to stop are out of scope.
blocks.zh:
任务是一个Gymnasium[2]环境,探测器从扰动开始移动,以匹配目标视图.
声窗是一种皮肤姿势,光束从中到达目标器官,基本没有骨气,肺气和肠气.
每个目标都是经过筛选的肝脏或肾窗口的视图.
它的起始位置统一在 ± 20 \pm 20 mm 的横向和高程范围内, ± 10 \pm 10 mm 轴线范围内,± 18 \p m 18\crc} 倾斜范围内和± 4\pm 4\crc} 滚动范围内.
每一步命令最高3毫米,每轴上0.05弧度。
观察中包含最后四个128×128128\time128帧,目标帧和可选器官口罩.
集经无终端状态,以十二步截断.
因此,任务是在一个已知窗口附近重新进行当地采购:从远处寻找一个窗口,并决定何时停止,超出了范围。

blocks.en: 3.2 Slots and interfaces
blocks.zh: 3.2 槽和接口

blocks.en: Table 2 lists the eight configurable components, the six plug slots among them, and what a replacement of each provides (slot terms and rules for reading the results: Box 1 ). The anatomy source, renderer and texture stage form the standard simulation engine, held at their reference components while the guide’s slots, mask source, controller and reward, are compared (Section 7 ); the engine’s slots stay pluggable (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 表2列出了8个可配置组件,其中6个插件插槽,以及每个插件的替换提供了哪些内容(阅读结果的集合术语和规则:框1 ). 解剖源、渲染器和纹理阶段构成标准模拟引擎,放在其参考部件上,而向导的插槽、遮罩源、控制器和奖励则进行比较(第7节);发动机插槽仍可插(表1)。

blocks.en: Tiers and labels. The primary results are the pre-specified analyses of the reference pipeline with its four reference texture stages (Section 6 and A ) and the primary real-frame results of Section 8.6 (every stage: Table 9 ). Every other result, the comparison of published methods, the controls and the replication cohorts included, is exploratory; a pre-specified rule gives it a decision word, and an estimation-only result has none (Supplementary S7). New analyses of data already seen are labeled post hoc, and descriptive results are counts or summaries with no test. Sections 7 and 8.1 to 8.5 and B report only exploratory results, so there a result is labeled only when it is also post hoc, estimation only, secondary or descriptive; values of the six held-out patients quoted from Section 6 keep their primary status.
blocks.zh: 等级和标签。 主要成果是对参考管道及其四个参考纹理阶段(第6节和A节)的预先确定分析,以及第8.6节(每个阶段:表9)的主要实际结果。 所有其他结果,对公布的方法、控制和包括的复制组的比较都是探索性的;预先规定的规则给它一个决定词,而只估计的结果是没有的(补充S7)。 对已经看到的数据进行的新分析被贴上 " 事后特别 " 的标签,描述性结果被计数或摘要,没有测试。 第7节和第8.1至8.5节以及B节只报告探索性结果,因此,只有在事后、只估计、二级或描述性结果时才会给结果贴上标签;第6节引用的6名被扣留的病人的数值保持其初级地位。

blocks.en: Unit. The patient is the unit of inference, with n = 6 n=6 (the six held-out patients, also the original six; TRAIN: the 13 training patients). On the 20 replication CTs (also new, further or cohort CTs) and the 30 AMOS CTs, the CT is the unit. Seeds index trained artifacts, and every contrast is conditional on them.
blocks.zh: 单位. 患者为推论单位,n=6n=6(6名被搁置的患者,也是原6名;TRAIN:13名训练患者). 在20个复制型CT(也是新的、进一步的或分组型CT)和30个AMOS CT上,CT是单元. 种子指数训练出来的文物,每个对比都以它们为条件.

blocks.en: Intervals. Brackets give a 95% CI of the per-patient or per-CT paired difference: a patient-cluster bootstrap CI for primary results and a paired t t CI for exploratory results. k k / n n counts the patients or CTs that share the sign of the mean.
blocks.zh: 间断. Brackets给出95%的每患者或每CT配对差异的CI:初级结果的患者集群靴状CI和探索性结果的配对 t CI. kk / n n 计算出与该平均值一致的患者或 CT 。

blocks.en: Decisions. A primary contrast is a difference when its CI excludes 0 and at least 5 of 6 patients share its sign. An exploratory contrast is a difference when its Holm-adjusted paired t t -test within its family gives p < 0.05 p<0.05 and at least 5 of 6 patients share its sign. On the 20 replication and 30 AMOS CTs, a sign-flip test with Holm decides, without a sign count. Every “lower” decision against one of our reference components is reported in the main text.
blocks.zh: 决定。 一种主要对比是,当其CI将0和至少6名患者中的5名与它同音时,这种对比是不同的。 试探性对比是一个差异,因为其家庭内的Holm调整配对 t - t测试给出了p < 0.05 p < 0.05,6名患者中至少有5人共享其标志。 在20次复制和30次AMOS CT上,由霍尔姆决定的标志-flip测试,没有标志计数. 主文中报告了针对我们参考内容之一的“较低”决定。

blocks.en: No difference detected is not equivalence. The post hoc MDD gives each slot’s resolution; only a TOST shows equivalence, named if post hoc.
blocks.zh: 没有检测到的区别不是等效的. 之后的 MDD 给出每个槽的分辨率; 只有 TOST 显示等效性, 如果是 之后的 。

blocks.en: Rows. Privileged rows carry a dagger in every table, and secondary and estimation-only rows never carry a decision. Except in the skin-tangent contact experiment, every absolute error is conditional on the target-anchored plane; contact-off rows keep the start lift and the 5 mm press clamp below that plane. Where no other reason is given, a run that is not reported did not pass the provenance checks.
blocks.zh: 诸行. 私家行在每张桌子上都携带一把匕首,次要的和仅估计的行从不携带决定权. 除了皮肤-触控接触实验外,每个绝对错误都以目标-触控平面为条件;接触-离线列保持起动升力和该平面下方5毫米的压电钳. 在没有提出其他理由的情况下,未报告的运行没有通过出处检查。

blocks.en: Where to look. B gives every pre-specified decision in full, keyed to the rows of Tables 5 and 1 .
blocks.zh: 何处看. B给出了每一个预先指定的决定的完整,按键为表5和表1的行.

blocks.en: 3.3 Anatomy, windows and contact
blocks.zh: 3.3 解剖、窗口和接触

blocks.en:
Anatomy comes from 19 public TotalSegmentator CTs [ 3 ] , split by patient into 13 training and six held-out cases that no component trained in this study saw (Fig. 2 ).
The skin comes from the same CT, so probe seating needs no registration.
Each accepted window passes eight screens (Supplementary S5), and its beam follows the inward skin normal or tilts toward the organ by at most 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} .
Liver windows lie on the anterior to right anterolateral abdomen, kidney windows on the flanks, and some in-plane rotations break the clinical display convention (Supplementary S5).
No sonographer rated a window or its view.
Every held-out patient has at least 5 liver and 11 kidney windows.
blocks.zh:
解剖学来自19个公共总分CT[3],被患者分为13个训练,以及6个被搁置的病例,而本研究中没有培训的成分(图2).
皮肤来自相同的CT,因此探针座椅不需要注册.
每个接受的窗口通过8个屏幕(补充S5),其光束跟随内向皮肤正常或向器官倾斜,最多10~10~10~circ}。
肝窗位于右角角角腹部前侧,侧翼为肾窗,部分机体自转打破了临床展示常规(补充S5).
没有音响学家给一个窗口或它的视图评分.
每个被搁置的病人至少有5个肝脏和11个肾窗.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : The patient’s CT skin, its screened windows and the contact plane, shown for training patient s0011.
(a) The skin surface extracted from the patient’s labeled CT, with the liver and kidneys inside.
Dots mark the faces of the screened acoustic windows on the skin: 50 for the liver and 63 for the kidneys.
Each stroke points along its window’s beam into the body.
Hollow dots lie on the far side of the body from the viewer.
(b) The probe seated at the top-ranked liver window, in the world frame of the MuJoCo scene.
The contact plane, the top face of the static MuJoCo box, passes through the window face perpendicular to the beam axis.
At this window the beam tilts 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} from the skin normal toward the liver, so the plane is not tangent to the skin.
Contact uses only this plane, not the skin surface.
The fan is the slicing plane of the probe, painted with the CT labels it samples (orange liver, green gallbladder, blue vessel, grays other tissue).
(c) The physics render at this pose and its CT label slice, mapped into the measured sector geometry without domain randomization and with a fixed speckle seed.
blocks.zh:
图2:病人的CT皮肤、经筛选的窗户和接触机,用于培训病人S0011。
(a) 从患者标注的CT中提取的皮肤表面,内含肝脏和肾脏.
圆点标注经筛选的声窗在皮肤上的脸部:肝部50张,肾部63张.
每根中风都沿着窗户的横梁冲入身体。
洞点从观者处卧在身体远处.
(b) 国家 探测器坐落在最顶级的肝窗上,在穆乔科场景的世界框架.
接触平面,静态的MuJoCo盒的顶部面,通过窗面垂直到梁轴处.
在这个窗口,光束从皮肤正常向肝脏倾斜10~10~10~circ],所以飞机与皮肤不切合.
接触只使用这个平面,而不是皮肤表面.
风扇是探测器的切片平面,用CT标签涂上它样品(橙肝,绿色胆囊,蓝色容器,灰色的其他组织).
(c)) 物理在这种姿势下渲染及其CT标签切片,映射到测量的扇区几何上,没有域随机化,并有固定的斑点种子.

blocks.en:
USB Gym seats the probe at a window screened on the patient’s CT skin.
MuJoCo presses it against a plane through the target window face, perpendicular to the target beam.
Because the plane carries the target’s depth and beam direction into the dynamics, we treat this target-anchored contact and the start lift onto it as privileged structure.
The plane is tangent to the skin only at 15 of the 60 evaluation windows and tilted from it by up to 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} at the other 45.
The press is a position clamp at 5 mm below the plane, about 8.5 N in a steady press, and the tissue is rigid.
Each 0.1 s control step integrates the commanded twist into a target pose without feedback, then simulates 20 ms of physics through a weld with a 0.02 s time constant.
The probe is thus a lagged position servo.
Under the CT-mask servo base, it trails its command by a mean 3.40 mm with contact, press included, and 2.09 mm without (post hoc).
Starts below the plane, 40 of the 60, are lifted along its normal, the target beam axis, by a mean 6.4 mm (post hoc).
Afterwards, the axial start offset spans − 9.4 -9.4 to − 0.6 -0.6 mm, so no start lies deeper than the target face (post hoc).
blocks.zh:
美国B 在病人的CT皮肤上,
MuJoCo通过目标窗面对着飞机按压,与目标梁垂直.
因为飞机携带着目标深度和射束方向进入动力学,所以我们把这个目标受干扰的接触和起动升降机当作特权结构.
飞机在60个评价窗口中只有15个是切合皮肤的,在另外45个窗口中从飞机上倾斜了最多10 ∘ 10 ^{\circ}.
新闻机是飞机下方5毫米处的一个位置夹,在稳定的新闻机中约为8.5N,组织僵硬.
每个0.1s控制步骤将指令的扭矩整合到一个没有反馈的目标姿势中,然后通过一个0.02s时间常数的焊接模拟20ms的物理.
因此,探测器是一种落后的位置伺服器。
在CT-mask伺服器基地下,它以平均3.40毫米与接触,包括新闻,以及2.09毫米无(后临时)跟踪指挥.
平面下方的起步,60系中的40系,沿其正常,目标梁轴,以6.4毫米平均值(后临时)升空.
之后,轴线开始抵消的长度为-9.4-9.4至-0.6-0.6毫米,因此没有起点比目标面更深。

blocks.en: 3.4 Rendering and the standard texture stage
blocks.zh: 3.4 渲染和标准纹理阶段

blocks.en:
The reference renderer is a physics model seeded from the LOTUS defaults [ 12 ] (every term, and what the model leaves out: Supplementary S1).
Each label slice is a 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} fan of 160 scanlines with 512 samples to 120 mm depth.
Shadowing leaves at sample s s of scanline l l the energy E l , s = [ ∏ k = 1 s ( 1 − R l , k ) ] exp ( − 2 κ Δ z ∑ j = 1 s μ l , j ) , R l , k = ( Z l , k − Z l , k − 1 Z l , k + Z l , k − 1 ) 2 , E_{l,s}=\Bigl[\prod_{k=1}^{s}\left(1-R_{l,k}\right)\Bigr]\exp\Bigl(-2\kappa\,\Delta z\sum_{j=1}^{s}\mu_{l,j}\Bigr),\qquad R_{l,k}=\left(\frac{Z_{l,k}-Z_{l,k-1}}{Z_{l,k}+Z_{l,k-1}}\right)^{2}, (1) with R l , 1 = 0 R_{l,1}=0 , impedance Z Z , attenuation μ \mu , sample spacing Δ ​ z \Delta z and a fixed gain κ \kappa .
A depth-varying point spread function blurs a speckle field fixed to the image grid and drawn from one seed per run, or per episode under domain randomization (DR).
Targets and observations share this field, so they are identical images at the same pose.
The renderer’s acoustic constants and DR ranges are heuristic, not fitted to measured images.
In the default render (default constants, no DR), organs look almost equally bright, that is, nearly isoechoic: their echo strengths differ by at most 1 dB.
Organ boundaries are not drawn either, because their echoes are too weak for the display’s 50 dB range (Supplementary S1.10).
The standard texture stage, SonoSPADE, textures each organ from the CT label.
Frames are warped into the 46 ∘ 46^{\circ} sector of the 128 × 128 128\times 128 Vitale frames [ 15 ] , which narrows the 60 ∘ 60^{\circ} fan by a factor of 0.77.

渲染器的声学常数和DR射程是高压的,不适于测量的图像。

blocks.en:
SonoSPADE [ 4 ] , the only stage reading the CT label, is the standard engine’s texture stage, so label information reaches every standard frame (Section 8.4 ). The pre-specified oracle ladder of the primary results also runs three other texture settings (Fig. 1 ): untextured physics, CUT [ 36 ] and CycleGAN [ 14 ] .
We retrained the three networks once, with seed 0, on renders of eight training patients and 404 Vitale frames.
A learned mask comes from one of 12 texture-matched U-Net segmenters [ 43 ] , per stage and seed.
Each also trains on 42 annotated Vitale frames and the KidneyUS training split [ 73 ] , never on held-out patients, held-out real frames or AUL frames [ 78 ] .
blocks.zh:
SonoSPADE [4],唯一读取CT标签的舞台,是标准引擎的纹理舞台,因此标签信息达到了每个标准框架(第8.4节). 主结果预设的甲骨文阶梯还运行着另外三个纹理设置(图1):无纹理物理,CUT[36]和CycleGAN[14].
我们重新训练过三个网络, 种子0, 对8个训练病人和404 Vitale帧。
一个学习过的面具来自12个纹理匹配的U-Net分区器之一[43],每个舞台和种子.
每个人还使用42个附加说明的Vitale帧进行训练,KidneyUS的训练则分开[73],从未对被搁置的病人进行训练,被搁置的真帧或AUL帧[78].

blocks.en: 3.5 Match score and privileged channel

blocks.en:
The default reward, the match score S S of Eq. ( 2 ), combines organ-mask overlap with an in-sector appearance term and uses no pose.
For frames I I and I ∗ I^{\ast} with organ masks M M and M ∗ M^{\ast} , S = 0.6 ​ S seg ​ ( M , M ∗ ) + 0.4 ​ S app ​ ( I , I ∗ ) , S app = 1 2 ​ ( 1 + NCC Ω ​ ( I , I ∗ ) ) . S=0.6\,S_{\mathrm{seg}}(M,M^{\ast})+0.4\,S_{\mathrm{app}}(I,I^{\ast}),\qquad S_{\mathrm{app}}=\tfrac{1}{2}\bigl(1+\mathrm{NCC}_{\Omega}(I,I^{\ast})\bigr). (2) Here S seg S_{\mathrm{seg}} is the mean per-organ intersection over union (IoU) of five organs, and NCC Ω \mathrm{NCC}_{\Omega} is the normalized cross-correlation over the lit sector Ω \Omega .
The step reward is the gain in S S minus a small action cost.
The score can therefore also rate real frames (Section 8.6 ), but its pose sensitivity on real images is untested.
The privileged channel contains the true pose error, both poses, the CT masks and the analytic twist (Box 1 ).
A controller meant for a physical rig must not read this channel, which the environment returns by default (Listing 1 ).

blocks.en: 4 Interface, plug protocol and compute
blocks.zh: 页:1 接口、 插件协议和计算

blocks.en: 4.1 Observation, action and reward
blocks.zh: 4.1 观察、行动和奖励

blocks.en:
A controller receives the observation of Section 3.1 and returns a normalized twist; each step’s reward is the gain in S S minus the action cost (Section 3.5 ).
A texture stage, mask source or controller enters the environment through its texture or mask argument or its action, as in Listing 1 , and a CT case as a label volume with screened windows.
Plugged renderers and reward terms entered through adapters, code that replaces the render function or S S (Table 2 ).
In the CT-free configuration, organ masks come from a learned segmenter, no pose, CT mask or privileged channel reaches the controller or the reward, and only evaluation code reads the pose error.
It still uses segmenters and a servo base fit with CT labels and true poses of training patients, and target-anchored contact (Section 3.3 ).

blocks.en: 4.2 Plug protocol
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 插件协议

blocks.en:
Under the plug protocol, we swapped one slot at a time and held the rest of the loop at that slot’s condition in Table 5 or 1 .
A new method therefore meets the same 60 held-out episodes as its slot’s reference component and is evaluated at 12 steps only.
No plugged method is tuned: each runs with settings fixed before its held-out runs (controllers: Supplementary Table S3.4).
Reinforcement learners get the reference controller’s 57,600 environment steps, and imitation learners its 40,000 samples.
Learned methods run seeds 0 to 2, and SAM, MedSAM, SIMUS and the cross-entropy look-ahead run seed 0 only; plugged networks run batch normalization in evaluation mode.
Holm’s adjustment runs within five pre-specified families of 4 texture stages, 7 mask sources, 10 controllers, 2 rewards and 2 renderers; five further families, specified after these (Section 5.4 ), are never pooled with them.
blocks.zh:
在插件协议下,我们一次换一个插槽,并在表5或表1中保持该插槽状态的其余循环。
因此,一种新方法满足60次停机事件与其时间档的参考部分相同,只按12个步骤进行评估。
无插件方法调制:每套套件在停运运行前都有固定的设置运行(控制器:补充表S3.4).
强化学习者获得参考控制器的57,600个环境步骤,并模仿学习者40,000个样本。
所学方法运行的种子为0至2,SAM,MedSAM,SIMUS和横贯的外观-头部运行的种子为0;插入的网络运行的批量正常的评价模式.
Holm的调整范围在5个预先指定的家庭,包括4个纹理阶段、7个口罩来源、10个控制器、2个奖赏和2个造型器;另外5个家庭,在这些之后(第5.4节),从未与它们合用。

blocks.en: 4.3 Compute cost
blocks.zh: 4.3 计算费用

blocks.en:
All compute costs were measured on one Apple M5 Pro laptop with 24 GB of memory (Table 3 ).
On its CPU, one closed-loop step with a learned-mask policy takes a median 41.5 to 103.4 ms over the four reference texture stages, or 9.7 to 24.1 steps per second.
Training one reference policy on the laptop’s GPU took a median 0.79 h with CT masks, 1.02 h with learned masks and 1.32 h under domain randomization. All 27 reference training runs took 0.61 to 2.97 h, timed while three runs shared the laptop (every frame, step and training time: Supplementary Table S3.3).
The testbed, the analysis scripts and the table and figure builds were written, tested and run with the AI coding assistant Claude Code (Anthropic), on the models Claude Opus 4.8, Opus 5 and Opus 5.5; those scripts generate every table and figure data file from the archived results.
blocks.zh:
所有计算成本都用一台带有24GB内存的Apple M5 Pro笔记本电脑进行测量(表3 ).
在其CPU上,一个带有学习掩码策略的闭路步骤在四个参考纹理阶段的中位数为41.5至103.4毫秒,即每秒9.7至24.1步.
关于笔记本电脑GPU的一项参考政策是使用带CT口罩的中位值0.79小时、带有学过口罩的1.02小时和域随机化的1.32小时。 所有27次参考培训都花费了0.61至2.97小时的时间,而3次培训共用膝上型计算机(每一帧、台阶和培训时间:补充表S3.3)。
在Claude Opus 4.8、Opus 5和Opus 5.5模型上,用AI编码助理Claude Code(Anthropic)编写、测试和运行了试验床、分析脚本以及表格和图表结构;这些脚本从存档结果中生成每个表格和图表数据文件。

blocks.en: 5 Reference pipeline and evaluation design
blocks.zh: 5. 参考管道和评价设计

blocks.en: 5.1 Reference controller
blocks.zh: 5.1 参考控制器

blocks.en:
The reference controller adds a bounded learned residual to the servo base: a t = clip ⁡ ( b ⁡ ( M t , M ∗ ) + ρ t , ± a max ) , a_{t}=\operatorname{clip}\bigl(b(M_{t},M^{\ast})+\rho_{t},\;\pm a_{\max}\bigr), (3) where the residual ρ t \rho_{t} is bounded at half the twist bound a max a_{\max} (Section 3.1 ).
The servo base b b adapts the Mebarki et al. [ 25 ] servo: least squares on 500 training frame pairs maps per-organ mask moments, area and centroid, linearly to the analytic twist under its own mask source.
The residual imitates the analytic twist minus the base, then trains by REINFORCE [ 66 ] , a policy-gradient reinforcement learning (RL) method, with an imitation anchor; only training uses the true pose.
At inference the learned-mask servo reads no pose and no CT mask, a CT-free configuration evaluated only in simulation.
Policies keep batch normalization in training mode at evaluation (evaluation mode: Section 8.1 ).
blocks.zh:
参考控制器在服务器基数中添加一个有界限的学习余值: t = 剪辑 ⁡ (b ⁡ (M t, M ∗) + ρ t, ± 最大), a _{ t }=\ operatorname{ clip}\bigl (b(M_{t}, M^{\ast}) +\rho_{t},\\;\p  a m_{\max}\ bigr), (3) 残值 ρ t\rho_{t} 绑定在最大 a_{\max 的曲折的一半 } (第3.1节)
伺服碱b b 适应Mebarki等人. [25] servo:500个训练框上最小的方形对映每个器官口罩瞬间,面积和中心机器人,线性到自己口罩源下的分析曲折.
残部模仿分析曲折减去基座,然后通过REINFORCE[66]进行列车,是一种政策级强化学习(RL)方法,并带有仿真锚;只有训练使用真正的姿势.
推论中,学习的mask servo读不出姿势,也没有CT 面具,一种只在模拟中评价的CT无线配置.
政策使培训模式在评价时分批正常化(评价模式:第8.1节)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Oracle ladder
blocks.zh: 5.2 甲骨文阶梯

blocks.en:
The oracle ladder’s rungs see less and less simulator state on identical episodes, so the step between two rungs measures what that state is worth. 1. Pose oracle (privileged): the analytic twist. 2. CT-mask servo (privileged): Eq. ( 3 ) with CT masks. 3. Learned-mask servo: Eq. ( 3 ) with the stage’s texture-matched segmenter. 4. Servo base alone: b b with no residual, privileged under CT masks. 5. Static: no commanded motion. 6. Scripted sweep: a fixed motion that reads no image and does not aim at the target. Over the 12 steps, the probe is pressed 1.2 mm into the body along the beam for four steps, then fanned about its lateral axis, 1.15 ∘ per step, four steps out and four back, each with a 0.4 mm press to keep contact (commanded values). Neither gap name of Box 1 assigns a cause.
The RL contribution is a policy’s final error minus its error after imitation.

oracle 梯子在相同情况下的模拟状态越来越少,因此两个梯子之间的步骤可以衡量该状态的价值。 1. Pose oracle(特权):分析曲折。 2. CT-mask servo(特权):Eq(3)带CT口罩. 3. 与舞台纹理匹配的分线器相配的Eq.(3)。 4. 仅Servo基地:b b 无剩余,在CT口罩下享有特权. 5. 静态:没有命令动议。 6. 脚本扫描:不读图像,不瞄准目标的固定运动. 在12个步骤上,探测器沿梁向身体按1.2毫米,为4个步骤,然后扇着它的横向轴,每步1.15×××××××,4个步骤出,4个后,每个后按0.4毫米以保持接触(指令值). 框 1 的空格名称都不会指定一个原因 。
RL贡献是政策在模仿后的最后错误减去其错误.

blocks.en: 5.3 Episodes and metrics
blocks.zh: 5.3 教程和衡量标准

blocks.en:
Each configuration, or arm, runs 60 crossed episodes per seed, six held-out patients by two organs by five windows.
By design, every rung, seed and plugged method meets the same targets and starts.
Contact stays on and domain randomization (DR) off, except in the contact-off evaluations, one skin-tangent contact arm and one CT-mask DR ablation.
blocks.zh:
每个配置,或臂部,每个种子运行60个交叉切片,六个被两个器官挡住的病人5个窗口.
从设计上看,每个rung,种子和插件方法都符合相同的目标并开始.
接触保持和域随机化(DR)关闭,除非在接触关闭评价中,一个皮肤质接触臂和一个CT-mask DR衰竭.

blocks.en:
The primary metric is the final translation error in mm, the translational norm of the SE(3) logarithm of the final pose relative to the target.
Rotation error is the geodesic angle to the target orientation.
Success means ending within 5 mm and 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} , or within 10 mm and 10 ∘ 10^{\circ} , tolerances set here, not by a clinical source.
Post hoc secondary metrics are per-axis errors in the target probe frame and the keep-best error or IoU, the value at the highest-scoring step, selected without the pose.
Learnability is the Spearman correlation of the appearance term with closeness to the target pose.
Distances to real frames are the intensity Wasserstein-1 distance (W1), the kernel and Fréchet Inception distances (KID, FID) [ 67 , 68 ] and the area under the curve (AUC) of a classifier two-sample test (C2ST) [ 69 ] .
blocks.zh:
主度量是最终的翻译错误(mm),与目标相对的SE(3)对数的翻译规范.
旋转误差是大地测量角度到目标方向.
成功意味着在5毫米和5毫米以内,或者在10毫米和10毫米以内,在这里设定的耐受性,而不是临床来源.
特设二级度量衡后是目标探测框和保存-最佳度量衡误差或IoU,最高积分级的值,不设姿势选择.
可学习性是外观术语与目标姿势相近的Spearman相关.
与真帧的距离是强度瓦瑟斯坦-1距离(W1),内核和弗雷切特受体距离(KID,FID)[67,68],以及分类器双样试验(C2ST)[69]曲线下的区域(AUC).

blocks.en: 5.4 Statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 5.4 统计分析

blocks.en:
Inference and decision rules. A contrast is a per-patient paired difference of means over organ, window and seed.
Every contrast is conditional on the trained artifacts (texture networks, segmenters, bases and policies).
Primary results keep the pre-specified, unadjusted CI-and-sign rule of Box 1 , on a 95% patient-cluster bootstrap confidence interval (CI).
Its type-I error at n = 6 n=6 was 0.11 to 0.16 in simulation (post hoc).
Exploratory analyses therefore use the paired t t rule of Box 1 , a two-sided paired t t -test with 5 degrees of freedom, Holm-adjusted [ 70 ] within each pre-specified family.
No exact test can reach Holm’s threshold at n = 6 n=6 in a family of two or more, since the smallest two-sided exact sign-flip p p is 2 / 64 2/64 .
Exact sign-flip p p values and bootstrap CIs serve as sensitivity analyses.
blocks.zh:
推论与决定规则. 对比是每病人在器官,窗口和种子上对手段的对价差异.
每一种对比都取决于训练有素的文物(纹理网络、支架、基地和政策)。
基本结果保持了方框1的预先规定、未经调整的CI-和标志规则,在95%的患者-组群信任间隔(CI)上。
它的型I错误在n=6n=6时在模拟(后特设)中为0.11比0.16.
因此,探索性分析采用方框1中的配对t t规则,即双侧配对t t测试,自由度为5度,Holm调整[70]在每个预先指定的家族中.
任何精确的测试都不能在两个或两个以上家庭的n = 6 n = 6 时达到霍尔姆的阈值,因为最小的双侧精确标志-flip p是2 / 64 2/64.
精确的标志-flip p值和靴子CI作为敏感性分析。

blocks.en:
Replication cohorts. The 20 replication CTs are screened in a seeded order, and a CT is accepted only with at least 2 kidney windows, the minimum that training and evaluation use.
Their decision rule is the exact sign-flip test with Holm.
An external replication cohort in simulation uses 30 CTs of the public AMOS 2022 dataset [ 71 ] , with sign-flip p p values from 1,000,000 random sign vectors.
AMOS records no patient identifier, so the CT is the unit, and two CTs from one patient cannot be excluded.
The 79 eligible AMOS CTs are all 512 by 512 and 65 share one header pattern, so they may come from fewer scanners than AMOS as a whole; we make no statement about centers, vendors or scanners.
blocks.zh:
复制组 20个复制式CT按种子顺序进行筛选,只接受至少2个肾脏窗口的CT,这是训练和评价所用的最低限度。
他们的决定规则是和Holm一起进行精确的标志-flip测试.
模拟中的一个外部复制组使用30个CT的公用AMOS 2022数据集[71],其标志-flip p值来自1,000,000随机标志矢量.
AMOS没有记录病人的识别特征,因此CT是单位,不能排除一个病人的两个CT.
79个合格的AMOS CT全部是512乘以512,65共用一个信头图案,因此它们可能来自比整个AMOS更少的扫描仪;我们没有就中心,销售商或扫描仪做出说明.

blocks.en:
Timing of specification. The pre-specified analyses were not formally pre-registered.
Results of an earlier version of this testbed on the same six held-out patients were known when the primary analyses were specified.
The plug protocol was fixed before any plugged method ran on held-out or cohort patients.
The paired t t rule was chosen after post hoc paired t t -tests on the 25 ladder contrasts had been seen (Section 6.4 ).
Some exploratory runs began before their decision rules were fixed (Supplementary Table S4.1).
They are five of the gap-cause level sets, the seed-0 look-ahead runs, SonoSPADE’s undirected-motion episodes, the planted-deficit RL runs and the two extra SonoSPADE texture seeds of the texture-budget test.
The SAMUS and LPIPS priors were set after the SAM, MedSAM and reward results had been seen.
Three further exploratory experiments were each fixed before their runs: learned-mask controllers with new learner seeds, skin-tangent contact and canonical phantoms.
Earlier learned-mask controller results have no pre-specified rule ( B.3 ).
A benchmark baseline is set on the 20 cohort CTs by a rule fixed before those runs, its components known.
A final set of follow-up runs was specified after nearly all other results had been seen, though before its own runs.
It has no decision rule, and each of its results is labeled estimation only (Supplementary S7).
blocks.zh:
规格的时间安排。 预先指定的分析没有正式预先登记。
在指定初级分析时,已经知道对这6名被搁置的病人进行试验的较早版本的结果。
插头协议是在任何插头方法运行于被扣留的病人或组群病人之前被固定的.
配对 t t 规则是经过25个梯形对比面上的临时配对 t 测试后选定的(第6.4节)。
一些探索性运行在决定规则确定之前就开始了(补充表S4.1)。
它们是5个空隙导致的关卡、0号种子的外观前卫、SonoSPADE的无定向运动、栽培缺陷的RL跑以及纹理预算测试的两个额外索诺SPADE纹理种子。
SAMUS和LPIPS的前身是在看到SAM,MDSAM和奖励结果后设定的.
运行前又分别固定了三个探索性实验:有新学习者种子的学习-面具控制器,皮肤-凝固接触器和犬类幽灵.
早期的学习任务控制器结果没有预先指定的规则(B.3 ).
在20组CT上设定了基准基线,这是在运行之前确定的规则,其组成部分已知。
在看到几乎所有其他结果之后,尽管在其本身的运行之前,已经确定了最后一套后续运行。
它没有决定规则,每项结果只是标注在估计上(补充S7)。

blocks.en:
From a 16.03 mm static start, the privileged pose oracle nearly reaches the target, at 1.53 mm, but the CT-mask servo stays far from it, at 11.64 to 11.81 mm (primary; Table 4 ).
The oracle-to-CT-mask gap is + 10.28 +10.28 mm [ + 9.21 +9.21 , + 11.39 +11.39 ] with physics frames (6/6) and within 0.17 mm of that with the other stages.

从16.03毫米的静态起,特权姿势甲骨几乎达到目标,为1.53毫米,但CT-mask伺服器远离它,为11.64至11.81毫米(初级;表4)。
甲骨文对CT-mask间隙为+10.28+10.28毫米[+9.21+9.21,+11.39+11.39],物理框架(6/6),与其它阶段相距0.17毫米以内.

blocks.en:
Without CT masks, three of the four learned-mask servos end at 16.50 to 16.90 mm, + 0.5 +0.5 to + 0.9 +0.9 mm above the static start (paired t t CIs − 2.00 -2.00 to + 3.41 +3.41 mm; post hoc; Fig. 2 ).
SonoSPADE’s ends at 13.11 mm, − 2.92 -2.92 mm [ − 5.73 -5.73 , − 0.10 -0.10 ] from the static start, 5/6 (paired t t p p 0.045, not detectable after Holm; post hoc).
At 5 mm and 5 ∘ , 8.3 to 10.0% of CT-mask and 1.1 to 5.6% of learned-mask final episodes succeed, against 100% for the oracle (post hoc).
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 6.2 The CT-to-learned-mask gap by texture stage
blocks.zh: 6.2 (中文(简体) ). 按纹理阶段划分的 CT 到任务差距

blocks.en:
The CT-to-learned-mask gap is larger with physics, CUT and CycleGAN frames, + 4.92 +4.92 , + 5.26 +5.26 and + 4.80 +4.80 mm (5/6, 6/6 and 5/6), than with SonoSPADE frames, + 1.43 +1.43 mm [ + 0.86 +0.86 , + 2.11 +2.11 ] (6/6).
The gap compares policies trained under different mask sources, so it does not estimate what better masks would remove.
With texture-matched segmenters, per-tissue texture gives the lowest learned-mask error.
Its learned-mask final lies 3.38 to 3.78 mm below the others’ (5/6 each).
SonoSPADE alone also reads the CT label slice (Section 8.4 ).
Per-tissue texture gives the most pose-sensitive appearance term of the four stages.
Its learnability is 0.613, against at most 0.548 for the others (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: 6.3 Fine-tuning and translation error
blocks.zh: 第6.3条 微调和翻译错误

blocks.en:
The servo base accounts for nearly all of the improvement; imitation and REINFORCE each change the final translation error by less than 0.5 mm.
The CT-mask servo base alone ends at 11.65 mm.
The largest RL contribution, + 0.47 +0.47 mm [ + 0.06 +0.06 , + 0.90 +0.90 ] with CUT frames and learned masks, falls short of the decision rule (4/6).

blocks.en: 6.4 Contact, texture under CT masks and domain randomization
blocks.zh: 6.4 CT口罩下的接触、纹理和域随机化

blocks.en:
With contact off at evaluation, the CT-mask servo ends at 14.4 to 14.8 mm, 2.7 to 3.0 mm farther (6/6 per stage).
With contact, the scripted sweep, which reads no image, also ends with smaller tilts: 3.57 and 3.10 ∘ out of plane and in plane, no larger at tilted windows, against 9.67 and 8.30 ∘ without contact (post hoc).
Every servo in Table 4 thus owes part of its absolute accuracy to the target-anchored plane (Section 3.3 ).
On 20 new CTs, contact off raises the final error by 2.14 mm [1.68, 2.60] (20/20) for the CT-mask servo base and 2.02 to 2.13 mm for CT-mask final policies (exploratory; estimation only; Supplementary S7).
With contact on and CT masks, only physics against SonoSPADE frames has a stage-pair CI excluding 0, + 0.13 +0.13 mm [ + 0.02 +0.02 , + 0.25 +0.25 ], 4/6, short of the decision rule.
No interval of the domain-randomization ablation excludes zero (descriptive; A.4 and A.5 ).

在接触中,脚本扫描,读不出图像,也以较小的倾斜结束:3.57和3.10 QQ出机和在飞机中,倾斜的窗户没有更大的倾斜,相对于9.67和8.30 QQ没有接触(后临时).

Re-tested post hoc with paired t t -tests, Holm-adjusted within each family, 11 of the 25 ladder contrasts reach Holm’s threshold: every oracle-to-CT-mask gap, every CT-to-learned-mask gap and every learned-mask SonoSPADE-against-stage contrast.

blocks.en: 6.5 What limits the CT-mask servo
blocks.zh: 6.5 军事 限制 CT- mask 服务器的内容

blocks.en:
The CT-mask servo leaves headroom in the match score.
This subsection is exploratory.
Privileged look-ahead values average look-ahead seeds 0 to 2.
The servo base barely predicts the analytic twist on five of six axes (held-out R 2 R^{2} at most 0.13).
Under CT masks, its elevational error grows from 8.08 mm at step 12 to 13.75 mm at step 36, and its roll from 4.14 to 10.68 ∘ (6/6 each; post hoc).
The oracle-to-CT-mask gap is not attributed to one cause (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
Under CT masks, 0/60 (0%) of targets have a pose 5 mm or more away scoring within 0.01 of the target’s own score (0/6 patients with a majority).
Privileged look-ahead ascent on the CT-mask match score ends at 8.55 mm, against 11.65 mm for the servo base and 1.53 mm for the pose oracle.
Privileged look-ahead ascent on the CT-mask match score ends below the servo base by 3.10 mm [0.14, 6.05] (6/6; conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).

The testbed exposes headroom between the servo base (11.65 mm) and the pose oracle (1.53 mm) that this controller does not close.

blocks.en: 7 Results: published methods in the guide’s three slots
blocks.zh: 页:1 结果:指南三个档次中公布的方法

blocks.en:
Of the 19 contrasts in the guide’s three slot families, 4 differ and 15 do not, 8 of these under privileged CT masks and 2 within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (post hoc TOST; Table 5 , Fig. 1 ).
Post hoc slot MDDs are 0.085 to 2.14 mm, smallest in the reward slot, where images act only through the residual.
All 27 published methods ran under one protocol (Section 4.2 ) with pre-specified rules (Section 5.4 ); the results are exploratory, and B gives each decision. This section reports the 20 in the guide’s slots; the 7 in the engine’s slots are in Table 1 .
blocks.zh:

后临时插槽MDD为0.085至2.14毫米,在奖励插槽中最小,图像只能通过剩余部分进行操作.
所有27种公布的方法都根据一项协议(第4.2节),并有预先规定的规则(第5.4节);结果都是探索性的,B给出了每项决定。 本节报告指南槽中的20个;发动机槽中的7个列于表1。

blocks.en: 7.1 Mask source
blocks.zh: 第7.1条 遮罩来源

blocks.en:
None of the first family’s seven mask sources differs detectably from the stage-matched U-Net: they end at 12.76 to 14.88 mm on SonoSPADE frames, against 13.13 mm.
SonoSPADE frames give the smallest CT-to-learned-mask gap, so differences in this slot may be compressed.
The four torchvision networks [ 44 , 45 , 47 , 46 ] train from random weights and nnU-Net [ 48 ] trains 2 epochs against its default of 1,000, all on the U-Net’s simulated and real frames.
blocks.zh:
第一家族的7个面具来源都与舞台匹配的U-Net没有明显不同:它们以12.76至14.88毫米的SonoSPADE帧结束,对13.13毫米。
SonoSPADE帧给出最小的CT到学习-任务间隙,因此这个槽中的区别可能被压缩.
四个火炬视网[44,45,47,46] 列车从随机重量和nnU-Net[48] 列车的预设时间为1000个,全部在U-Net的模拟和真实框架上.

blocks.en:
Neither SAMUS [ 51 ] nor any of the four networks with ImageNet-pretrained backbones differs detectably from the U-Net.
Within the families, only FCN ResNet-50 with an ImageNet backbone is shown equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (post hoc TOST).
SAMUS is prompted with boxes from the U-Net’s own mask, not with its native point prompts, so this row measures what SAMUS adds to the U-Net’s detections.
The pretrained networks use the from-scratch recipe (4,000 iterations), which is not tuned for pretrained backbones.
ImageNet pretraining is not shown to change the mask-slot results of the torchvision segmenters ( n = 6 n=6 ).
blocks.zh:
SAMUS [51] 和拥有ImageNet前置骨干骨干的四个网络中没有一个与U-Net明显不同.
在家庭内部,只有带有ImageNet主干线的FCN ResNet-50显示在±1\pm 1 mm(后临时TOST)范围内.
SAMUS是用U-Net自己的面具的盒子来推动的,而不是用它的原点提示,所以这行测量SAMUS在U-Net的检测中添加的内容.
预训网络使用自训菜谱(4,000迭代),不为预训骨干调制.
ImageNet预训不显示更改火炬视网隔扇的遮罩槽结果(n=6n=6).

blocks.en: 7.2 Controller
blocks.zh: 7.2 主计长

blocks.en:
Under privileged CT masks on SonoSPADE frames, none of the PPO [ 54 ] , SAC [ 55 ] , behavior cloning (BC) [ 60 ] and DAgger [ 61 ] residuals differs detectably from the slot’s reference, the REINFORCE residual [ 66 ] at 11.69 mm.
Only PPO is shown equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (post hoc TOST).
The TD3 [ 56 ] and A2C [ 57 ] residuals raise the error, by + 8.54 +8.54 and + 6.74 +6.74 mm (6/6 each; Holm p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
Each residual adds at most a max / 2 a_{\max}/2 to the servo base’s twist in Eq. ( 3 ), a bounded search around the base.
With seeds 0 and 1, TD3 moves the probe identically on SonoSPADE and physics frames in all 60 episodes, and each TD3 actor was found saturated, adding one constant offset at the residual bound whatever the image (post hoc).
Without the servo base, full-twist BC raises the error by + 7.92 +7.92 mm (6/6, Holm p p 0.006).
The other controllers without the base, full-twist PPO and DAgger and DQN [ 58 ] , show no detectable difference.
The unadjusted intervals of full-twist DAgger and DQN exclude zero.
TD3, A2C, DQN and full-twist BC and DAgger all end above the 16.03 mm static start.
The Stable-Baselines3 (SB3) [ 59 ] learners start from random weights and REINFORCE from imitation; a decision describes this training (Section 4.2 ), not the algorithm.
blocks.zh:
在索诺SPADE帧上的特权CT口罩下,PPO[54],SAC[55],行为克隆(BC)[60]和Dagger[61]残片都与槽的参考文献,REINFORCE残片[66]在11.69毫米时可察觉到有差异.
只有 PPO 显示在 ± 1\pm 1 mm 内( post hoc TOST) 。
TD3 [56] 和 A2C [57] 残片使误差上升,增加了+8.54+8.54和+6.74+6.74毫米(6/6;Holm p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。
每个剩余部分最多在 Eq. (3 ) 中给伺服器基础的扭矩加一个最大值 / 2 a_{\max}/2 , 这是围绕该基础的边框搜索 。
有了0和1号种子,TD3在所有60集中同样在SonoSPADE和物理帧上移动探测器,每个TD3演员被发现饱和,无论图像(后特设)在剩余绑定处都增加了一个常数抵消.
没有伺服器基础,全转式BC将误差提高+7.92+7.92毫米(6/6,Holm p.006)。
其他没有底部,全扭矩PPO和Dagger和DQN[58],没有显示可探测的区别.
全调Dagger和DQN的未调整间隔排除0.
TD3,A2C,DQN和全Twist BC和Dagger均在16.03毫米静态启动上方结束.
Stable-Baselines3(SB3)[59]学习者从随机加权开始,REINFORCE从模仿开始;一个决定描述了这种训练(第4.2节),而不是算法.

blocks.en:
Without CT masks, one published controller detectably lowers its servo base’s error, with physics frames only.
In a pre-specified learned-mask controller experiment, we retrained the DAgger and BC residuals with new learner seeds; at run time they read only the frame history and target frame ( B.3 ).
They learned from a privileged pose-oracle teacher, on a base and segmenters fit with true poses and CT labels of training patients.
They were chosen by CT-mask results on the same six patients, so the experiment is not independent of their earlier runs; new seeds remove only the seed part of that selection.
Under learned masks with the physics stage, the DAgger residual gives a lower final translation error than the learned-mask servo base ( − 3.17 -3.17 mm [ − 5.04 -5.04 , − 1.31 -1.31 ], 6/6; exploratory).
With physics frames and learned masks, the testbed separates 1 of the three method pairs of this arm at n = 6 n=6 (exploratory).
The separated pair is the DAgger residual and its base, which end at 14.02 and 17.20 mm, against 16.03 mm for the static start; DAgger and BC are not separated.
With SonoSPADE frames and learned masks, no pair of methods in this arm is separated at n = 6 n=6 (exploratory).
Equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown for any of its contrasts.
With physics frames, the BC residual’s unadjusted interval excludes zero (Holm p p 0.177).
blocks.zh:
没有CT口罩,一个公布的控制器可探测地降低其服务器基础的错误,只有物理框架.
在预先指定的学习任务控制器实验中,我们用新的学习者种子重新训练Dagger和BC残骸;在运行时,他们只读到帧历史和目标帧(B.3 ).
他们从一个有特权的姿势高手的老师那里学来的,在基座上和配有真实姿势的分身以及训练病人的CT标签.
他们被CT-mask结果选在同一6位患者身上,因此实验并不独立于他们之前的运行;新种子只去除该选择的种子部分.
在具有物理阶段的学习口罩下,Dagger残留给出了比学习-mask servo基础(−3.17-3.17毫米[−5.04-5.04,−1.31-1.31],6/6;探索性)较低的最终翻译错误.
带有物理框架和学习过的口罩,试验台以n=6n=6(探索)的方式分离出这个臂的三个方法对中的1个.
分离的配对是Dagger残基及其底部,末端为14.02毫米和17.20毫米,对静态启动为16.03毫米;Dagger和BC没有分离.
有了SonoSPADE帧和学习过的口罩,这个臂中没有任何一对方法在n=6n=6(探索)时分离.
±1\pm 1毫米范围内的等效度没有显示其任何对比度.
有了物理框架,BC残留的未调整间隔不包括0(Holm p0.177)。

blocks.en: 7.3 Reward
blocks.zh: 7.3 奖励

blocks.en:
SSIM and LPIPS end below the retrained match score S S , each by under a quarter of S S ’s 0.28 mm drift.
A new term replaces S S only in the REINFORCE step reward, under privileged CT masks, against S S retrained at 11.97 mm.
NMI [ 64 ] shows no detectable difference.
A reward row acts only through REINFORCE, which moved the error of the primary results by under 0.5 mm and did not recover a planted deficit, so a null row says little.
The SSIM [ 63 ] appearance term gives a lower final translation error than the paper’s S S in the reward potential slot ( − 0.047 -0.047 mm [ − 0.085 , − 0.009 ] [-0.085,-0.009] , 5/6; exploratory).
The LPIPS [ 65 ] appearance term gives a lower final translation error than the paper’s S S in the reward slot ( − 0.066 -0.066 mm [ − 0.122 , − 0.011 ] [-0.122,-0.011] , 5/6; exploratory).
Both meet the paired t t rule (Holm p p 0.049 and 0.028; exact sign-flip p p 0.0625 each).
For both, the pre-specified patient-by-seed interval excludes 0, while a post hoc crossed one includes it.
Every plugged reward is equivalent to S S within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (post hoc TOST).
The appearance terms train only with target and observation sharing one speckle field.
blocks.zh:
SSIM和LPIPS在重新训练的比赛分数SS以下结束,每分不到SS0.28毫米漂流的四分之一.
一个新术语仅在REINFORCE阶次奖励中取代S S,在特权CT口罩下,以11.97毫米重训练S S.
NMI [64] 显示无可测差异.
一个奖励行只通过REINFORCE来行动,它将主结果的误差移动了0.5毫米以下,并且没有恢复一个被埋设的亏空,所以一个无效行说得很少.
SSIM [63]的外观术语给出了低于论文中S在奖励潜在插槽中的最终翻译错误( - 0.047 - 0.047 mm [ - 0.085, - 0.009] [-0.085,-0.09], 5/6; 探索性).
LPIPS [65] 外观学术语给出了比奖赏槽中论文的S S (− 0.066 - 0.066 mm [− 0.122, − 0.011] [0.122,- 0.011], 5/6; 探索性) 较低的最终翻译错误.
两者均符合配对的 t t 规则(Holm p 0.049和 0.028;准确的标志-flip p 0.0625各).
对两者来说,预先指定的逐种患者间隔不包括0,而后临时跨越的间隔包括0.
每一次插头奖励均相当于±1\pm 1毫米范围内的S S(post hoc TOST).
外观术语仅与目标 和观测共享一个光谱场。

blocks.en: 7.4 Benchmark baseline
blocks.zh: 7.4 基准基线

blocks.en:
To test the testbed, we combined slot components: the authors’ unless a slot decision found a method lower.
Fixed before its runs, its components known, the rule used the six held-out patients, not the 20 cohort CTs that test it (Section 8.5 ).
Only the reward slot changed, to the SSIM appearance term, so no pipeline plugged in several slots was measured.
That choice rests on a small difference: SSIM’s − 0.047 -0.047 mm under privileged CT masks with SonoSPADE frames lies below the slot’s post hoc MDD of 0.085 mm. Its paired t t p p of 0.0246 lies 0.0004 below Holm’s first threshold, and its sign held in 2 of 3 learner seeds, shared with the retrained S S .
With SSIM, the residual ends at 11.92 mm, above the primary REINFORCE result of 11.69 mm.
The combination’s imitation start, behavior-cloning anchor, servo base and segmenters were fit with true poses and CT labels of training patients.
blocks.zh:
为了测试试验台,我们合并了槽组件:除非槽决定发现方法较低。
固定在运行前,其成分已知,该规则使用了六个被搁置的病人,而不是测试它的20组CT(第8.5节)。
只有奖励槽改变了,改为SSIM外观术语,所以没有测量插在几个插槽中的管道.
这一选择取决于一个小的差别:SSIM在带有SonoSPADE帧的特权型CT口罩下为0.047-0.047毫米,位于槽后0.085毫米的MDD以下。 其配对的t t t p 0. 0246 位于霍尔姆第一个阈值以下的 0.0004 ,其标志保存在 3 个学习者种子中的 2 个,与再训练的 S S 共享 。
与SSIM一起,残端为11.92毫米,高于11.69毫米的主力REINFORCE结果.
该组合的模仿开始,行为克隆锚,伺服器基础和分片器都符合训练病人的真实姿势和CT标签.

blocks.en:
This test runs on the standard engine; its physics-frame arm is reported in B.10 .
On 20 new CTs, the SonoSPADE combination gives a lower final translation error than the authors’ original pipeline (0.26 mm [ − 0.39 -0.39 , − 0.12 -0.12 ], 16/20, Holm p = 0.002 p=0.002 ; exploratory).
So, at 13.70 mm [12.68, 14.73], it is the benchmark baseline on the standard engine (exploratory), whose SonoSPADE frames are rendered from the CT label slice, so label information reaches the image.
It is equivalent to its learned-mask servo base within ± 1 \pm 1 mm ( − 0.01 -0.01 mm; TOST, Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ).
It is also equivalent to our reference pipeline (Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ).
Its difference from it is conditional on its six RL runs, and its crossed case-by-seed interval includes 0, so it may come from those runs rather than from the change of reward.
Retrained with the same procedure and seeds, S S ends 0.04 mm below the combination and differs from our reference pipeline by − 0.29 -0.29 mm (estimation only).
This control holds the training procedure and the seeds fixed; it does not make a difference of the combination a property of SSIM in general.
The combination ends far above the privileged pose oracle, by 12.24 mm (20/20; Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ; conditional on this renderer).
The rule (Table 9 ) ranks no other pipeline, such as the scripted sweep, the learned-mask controller arm or those of Supplementary S7.
blocks.zh:
这一试验在标准发动机上进行;其物理框架臂在B.10中报告。
在20个新的CT上,SonoSPADE组合给出的最终翻译错误低于提交人的原始管道(0.26毫米[−0.39-0.39,−0.12-0.12],16/20,Holm p=0.002p=0.002;探索性)。
因此,在13.70毫米[12.68,14.73]时,它是标准发动机(探索型)的基准基线,其SonoSPADE帧由CT标签切片制成,因此标签信息到达图像.
它相当于其在±1\pm 1毫米(−0.01-0.01毫米;TOST,霍尔姆p=3.8×10−6p=3.8\times 10×6})范围内的学习-面具服务器基.
它也相当于我们的参考管道(Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p = 3.8\times 10^{-6})。
它与它的区别取决于它的6个RL运行,它的跨度逐个种子间隔包括0,因此它可能来自这些运行而不是来自报酬的改变.
S S以相同的程序和种子重新训练,在组合下方结束0.04毫米,与我们的参考管道相差−0.29-0.29毫米(仅估计)。
这种控制使训练程序和种子固定;它并不改变一般SSIM的组合财产。
该组合远超特权姿势甲骨文,以12.24毫米(20/20;Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p = 3.8\times 10^{-6};以这个渲染器为条件)结束.
规则(表9)没有其他管道的排位,如脚本扫荡,学习-面具控制臂或补充S7的控制臂.

blocks.en:
A post hoc selection (Table 10 ), whose outcome predates the pre-specified rule, takes the lowest error on the six patients that measured it, so it can name another pipeline.
With the privileged CT mask, its lowest pipeline ends 9.32 mm [ 7.56 , 11.08 ] [7.56,11.08] above the pose oracle (6/6), not detectably below the CT-mask servo base ( − 0.80 -0.80 mm [ − 3.20 , + 1.60 ] [-3.20,+1.60] , 4/6; post hoc).
Selecting on five patients and scoring the sixth gives 11.87 mm, above the base’s 11.65 mm.
Without privileged input, its post hoc lowest pipeline ends 9.91 mm [ 7.39 , 12.43 ] [7.39,12.43] above the pose oracle (6/6) with label-conditioned frames.
No published component measured here, alone or in the rule’s combination, closes the gap to the pose oracle.
The task thus remains under-explored, with much room for research.
blocks.zh:
事后特设选择(表10),其结果早于预先指定的规则,对测量它的6个病人采取最低错误,因此可以命名另一个管道.
拥有特权的CT口罩,其最低的输油管在姿势甲骨(6/6)上方止于9.32毫米[7.56,11.08][7.56,11.08],在CT-mask伺服器基底以下无法探测(−0.80-0.80毫米[−3.20,+1.60][-3.20,+1.60],4/6;后临时).
选择5名病人,第6名得分为11.87毫米,高于基地的11.65毫米。
在没有特权输入的情况下,它的后置最低管线在姿势甲骨文上方的9.91毫米[7.39,12.43] [7.39,12.43] 端部(6/6)带有标签条件框架.
这里没有单独或按规则的组合衡量的已公布的组件会把空白拉近到姿势甲骨文.
因此,任务仍未得到充分探讨,研究的余地很大。

blocks.en: 8 Controls, sensitivity analyses and replication
blocks.zh: 第8条 控制、敏感性分析和复制

blocks.en: The analyses of this section ask whether the results of Sections 6 and 7 depend on the testbed’s settings or the six held-out patients (pre-specified criteria: Supplementary Table S4.2; outcomes: Table 7 ); all but the primary real-frame results of Section 8.6 are exploratory.
blocks.zh: 本节的分析询问,第6和第7节的结果是取决于试验床的设置还是取决于6名被搁置的病人(预先确定的标准:补充表S4.2;结果:表7);第8.6节除主要实际框架结果外,所有其他结果都是探索性的。

blocks.en: Table 7 : Controls, sensitivity analyses and replication: the question each answers and its outcome, absolute values first (exploratory). Supplementary Table S4.2 gives each criterion. Every contrast is conditional on the trained artifacts (texture networks, segmenters, bases and policies). Seeds index artifacts; the patient or CT is the sampling unit. Intervals: 95% paired t t with the patients sharing the sign. Criterion met: yes or no, inconclusive, descriptive, or, for a family of changes, how many differ.
blocks.zh: 表7:控制、敏感性分析和复制:每个问题答案及其结果,绝对值第一(探索)。 补充表S4.2列出每项标准。 每一种对比都取决于训练有素的文物(纹理网络、支架、基地和政策)。 种子指数文物;患者或CT为采样单位. 间距:95%的t与患者共用标注. 标准得到满足:是或否、无定论、描述性,或对一个变化家庭而言,有多少差异。

blocks.en: 8.1 Training variability, inference mode and renderer phantoms
blocks.zh: 8.1 培训变异性、推论模式和渲染器幻象

blocks.en:
The 95% prediction interval of the final error for one new training seed is ± 1.34 \pm 1.34 mm.
With BatchNorm in eval mode, the CT-mask physics and per-tissue finals, the learned-mask CUT and CycleGAN rows after imitation and the learned-mask CUT final change by up to 0.34 mm.
Two pre-specified outcomes change: the 0.5 mm bound on imitation and REINFORCE in the learned-mask CUT and CycleGAN arms, and the CT-mask stage-pair test of physics against the per-tissue stage.
BatchNorm mode changes policy rows by more than the texture stages do under CT masks; both modes are reported (exploratory).
blocks.zh:
1个新训练种子最终错误的预测间隔为95% ± 1.34\pm 1.34毫米.
采用eval模式的BatchNorm,CT-mask物理和每问题决赛,模仿后的学习-mask CUT和CycleGAN列以及学习-mask CUT最终变化可达0.34毫米.
两个预先指定的结果变化:在学习面具CUT和CycleGAN臂中装有仿制和REINFORCE的0.5毫米捆绑,以及针对每问题阶段的CT面具阶段物理试验.
BatchNorm模式改变政策行的时间超过CT口罩下的纹理阶段;两种模式都报告(探索).

blocks.en:
On canonical phantoms, the physics renderer, the original LOTUS code and SIMUS meet 5 of 8, 2 of 4 and 5 of 8 bands fixed before rendering, with 2, 2 and 1 not scorable (descriptive).
For the physics renderer and SIMUS, the anechoic disc’s contrast-to-noise ratio over the speckle signal-to-noise ratio of phantom H, 0.67 and 0.80, falls below its minimum of 0.90.
SIMUS’s shadow depth below the bone slab of phantom B, 0.00 mm, falls below its minimum of 10 mm.
Several bands are design checks that hold by the renderer’s construction.
No renderer is called realistic.
blocks.zh:
在光子幻象上,物理渲染器,原始的LOTUS代码和SIMUS在渲染前会遇到固定在8,2,4和8个波段的5个波段,其中2,2和1不可用(描述性).
对于物理学渲染器和SIMUS来说,无孔光碟相对于幽灵H, 0.67和0.80的光谱信号与噪声之比低于其最低的0.90。
SIMUS的影子深度低于幽灵B的骨板,0.00毫米,低于其最小的10毫米.
多个波段是设计检查,由渲染器的构造进行。
任何渲染器都不叫现实。

blocks.en: 8.2 Positive controls of RL training
blocks.zh: 8.2 积极控制RL培训

blocks.en:
On training patients, a PPO learner [ 59 , 54 ] trained through the same environment and 57,600-step budget ends within 3 mm of the pose oracle on a privileged easy variant in all three seeds, so the RL training loop can learn a correction (exploratory).
REINFORCE [ 66 ] does not recover half of a planted deficit under any of the three settings at 57,600 steps.
Nor does it recover half of a secondary deficit that halves the servo base’s command at execution (recovery statistic positive in 1 of 6 patients for every setting).
The outcome is inconclusive: on training patients, the planted bias lowers the final match score by only 0.008, below the visibility rule’s 0.03.
Raised to 1.0 mm per step, the largest value tried on TRAIN, the planted bias still lowers the final match score by only 0.023.
At this bias, REINFORCE removes 10%, 9% and 29% of the 7.60 mm lateral deficit with default settings, learned exploration and privileged pose shaping (exploratory; estimation only; Supplementary S7).
Their patient-bootstrap intervals are [8%, 12%], [7%, 11%] and [27%, 31%], and the recovery statistic is positive in 0 of 6 patients for every setting.
The PPO control shows that the training loop can learn, not that learning from images is possible, because its learner, observation and reward differ from REINFORCE’s (Fig. 3 a).
Every RL statement is scoped to this configuration and budget, and the RL null of Table 4 says nothing about RL in general.
blocks.zh:
在培训病人方面,通过同一环境培训的PPO学习者[59,54]和57,600步预算在3毫米内结束在所有3种种子中的特权易变体上,因此RL训练循环可以学习矫正(探索性).
REINFORCE [66]没有以57,600个步骤收回在三个设置中任何一个设置下的一半人种赤字.
也没有恢复一半的次级赤字(每场6名病人中有1名康复统计呈阳性),
结果没有定论:在训练病人方面,植入的偏差使最终的比赛得分仅降低了0.008,低于能见度规则0.03.
提升到每步1.0毫米,是TRAIN上尝试的最大值,所栽种的偏差仍然使最终的比分仅降低0.023.
在这种偏差下,REINFORCE消除了7.60毫米横向赤字的10%、9%和29%,这些赤字有默认设置、学习的探索和特殊姿势塑造(探索;仅估算;补充S7)。
他们的患者-玻色拉间隔为[8%,12%],[7%,11%]和[27%,31%],每场6名患者中的0人恢复统计呈阳性。
PPO控制显示训练循环可以学习,而不是从图像中学习是可能的,因为其学习者,观察和奖励与REINFORCE不同(图3 a).
每个RL语句都被限定为这个配置和预算,表4中无效的RL没有泛指RL.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Controls and replication: exploratory results, except the original six patients in (b), which are primary; daggers mark privileged inputs. (a) Top: SB3 PPO on the privileged easy variant, final error on training-patient episodes against environment steps, three seeds, with the static start, pass bound and pose oracle. Bottom: the REINFORCE control, the fraction of the planted lateral deficit left against iteration, three settings, pass line at one half. (b) Per-patient differences of the two cohort contrasts, original six and 20 cohort CTs, with means and 95% t t intervals, also for the original six, whose primary bootstrap intervals are in Table 4 . (c) Mean translation error against control step 0 to 36; the dotted line marks the evaluation horizon, step 12. Every contrast is conditional on the trained artifacts (texture networks, segmenters, bases and policies). Seeds index artifacts; the patient is the sampling unit.
blocks.zh: 图3:控制与复制:试探性结果,除(b)中原6名患者为主外;匕首标注特权输入. (a) 顶部:SB3 PPO关于特惠易变体,培训-病人事件的最后错误与环境步骤相对应,3种种子,有静态启动,通过束缚和姿势甲骨文。 底部:REINFORCE控制,植入的横向缺损相对于迭代留下的分量,3个设置,半通过线. (b) 两个组别(原始的6个组别和20个组别CT)的患者人均差异,包括手段和95% t的间隔,同样是原始的6个组别,其主要靴子间隔载于表4。 (c) 控制步骤0至36的均译误差;虚线标志评价视野,步骤12。 每一种对比都取决于训练有素的文物(纹理网络、支架、基地和政策)。 种子索引文物;患者为采样单位.

blocks.en: 8.3 Horizon and contact surface
blocks.zh: 8.3 地平线和接触表面

blocks.en:
At 36 steps, the CT-mask servo base ends at 18.34 mm and the learned-mask bases at 21.32 to 32.67 mm, above the 16.03 mm static start (Fig. 3 c).
Tripling the horizon changes the CT-mask servo error by + 6.69 +6.69 mm [ + 4.96 +4.96 , + 8.43 +8.43 ], 6/6; the 12-step horizon is not what holds the servo near 11.7 mm (exploratory).
At 36 steps the pose oracle ends at 0.14 mm; its 12-step residual of 1.53 mm is a horizon and gain effect (exploratory).
Post hoc, the logs trace this residual to lagged tracking: after each step, the oracle’s probe trails its command by a mean 4.60 mm (Supplementary Table S2.12).
Every plugged method is evaluated at 12 steps, which can hide later drift (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
在36步,CT-mask服务器基端为18.34毫米,学习-mask基端为21.32至32.67毫米,高于16.03毫米静态启动(图3 c).
拓扑地平线改变CT-mask伺服器误差为+6.69+6.69毫米[+4.96+4.96,+8.43+8.43]],6/6;12步地平线不是支撑伺服器接近11.7毫米(勘探)的地方.
在36步处,姿势甲骨文以0.14毫米结束;其12步残积1.53毫米是地平线和增益效应(探索).
后临时,日志追踪到这个残存物的跟踪滞后:每一步后,甲骨文的探测器以平均4.60毫米(补充表S2.12)追踪到它的指令.
每种插头方法按12个步骤进行评估,这可以隐藏以后的漂移(第4.2节)。

blocks.en:
Replacing the target-anchored plane with a skin-tangent plane where the start pose’s beam axis enters the skin, with no artifact retrained, changes no level of the oracle ladder detectably ( + 0.36 +0.36 to + 3.53 +3.53 mm; Holm p p 0.093 to 0.620; MDD 1.71 mm at the experiment’s median SD; Table 3 ).
The start is still drawn around the target pose, so this plane lies near the target window.
This experiment therefore measures a change of contact geometry, not contact free of target information.
Both servo bases keep the calibrations fit with the target-anchored plane.
Equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown for any level (TOST, Holm p p 0.337 to 1.000).
Both servo-base differences are positive in 6/6 patients, with unadjusted intervals above 0, [ + 0.89 +0.89 , + 6.18 +6.18 ] and [ + 0.29 +0.29 , + 5.72 +5.72 ] mm.
In a secondary comparison, the pose oracle’s success at 5 mm and 5 ∘ falls by 62 [46, 77] percentage points (Supplementary Table S6.2).
blocks.zh:
将目标悬浮平面换成皮质平面,使起始姿势的梁轴进入皮肤,没有经过文物再训练,不可探测地改变甲骨文阶梯的水平(+0.36+0.36至+3.53 mm;Holm p 0.093至0.620;MDD 1.71 mm在实验的中位SD;表3)。
起步仍然在目标姿势周围拉动,所以这架飞机就在目标窗口附近.
因此,这一实验测量接触几何的改变,而不是没有目标信息的接触。
两个伺服器基地都保持校准与靶心飞机相适应.
±1\pm 1毫米范围内的等效度不显示于任何关卡(TOST,Holm p 0.337–1.000).
6/6位患者的伺服基差均呈阳性,未调整间隔高于0,[+0.89+0.89,+6.18+6.18]]和[+0.29+0.29,+5.72+5.72]mm.
在第二次比较中,姿势甲骨文在5毫米和5 的成绩下降了62[46,77]个百分点(补充表S.6.2)。

blocks.en: 8.4 Label-channel controls and texture budget
blocks.zh: 8.4 标签通道控制和纹理预算

blocks.en:
Three controls ask whether the SonoSPADE lead comes from label access: out-of-plane label offsets, permuted organ identities and a label-painted stage.
These controls describe label-conditioned stages as a class; the published per-tissue method is used unchanged.
Permuting the organ identities raises the total final error from 13.13 to 21.69 mm, by + 8.56 +8.56 mm [ + 4.46 +4.46 , + 12.65 +12.65 ].
Label offsets of 3 and 6 mm change it by + 0.01 +0.01 and + 0.49 +0.49 mm.
Applied to the observations only, they shift the final elevational displacement by − 0.36 -0.36 mm [ − 0.87 -0.87 , + 0.14 +0.14 ] and − 0.82 -0.82 mm [ − 1.52 -1.52 , − 0.11 -0.11 ].
For both offsets, a shift of at least half the offset is not shown (exploratory).
With the label offset reversed ( − 3 -3 mm), the shift is + 0.40 +0.40 mm [ − 0.20 -0.20 , + 1.01 +1.01 ] (secondary).
Given a label slice taken 3 or 6 mm out of plane, the per-tissue stage leads its matched segmenter to follow the given label rather than the anatomy in the physics input.
Its label-following index is + 0.142 +0.142 [ + 0.116 +0.116 , + 0.168 +0.168 ] and + 0.281 +0.281 [ + 0.247 +0.247 , + 0.315 +0.315 ], or 53% and 64% of complete following.
With organ identities permuted in the label, the masks follow the permuted identities ( + 1.137 +1.137 [ + 1.038 +1.038 , + 1.235 +1.235 ], 6/6).
A non-learned label-painted physics stage lowers the learned-mask base error below physics ( − 2.97 -2.97 mm; exploratory) and recovers 0.73 [0.33, 1.34] of the per-tissue lead.
Equivalence with the per-tissue stage is not shown ( n = 6 n=6 ).
Its TOST within ± 1 \pm 1 mm has a power of about 0.01.
The painted stage brightens the kidney from a depth-driven median of 1.89 toward a normal liver-to-kidney ratio of 1.14 [ 72 ] , and draws 12 dB capsule lines, so its 0.73 mixes label access with renderer calibration.
Each label-control contrast that meets the decision rule has its sign in 6/6 patients and an exact sign-flip p p of 0.031 (paired t t and Holm p p : 0.003 and 0.009 for the permuted total error, both at most 3.3 × 10 − 5 3.3\times 10^{-5} for the masks, 0.029 for painting).

对于这两个抵销,没有显示至少一半抵销额的变动(探索)。

符合决定规则的每个标签控制对比在6/6患者中都有其标志,准确的标志-flip p为0.031(paired t t and Holm p:0.003 and 0.009 for the permuted toal error, 最多为3.3×10 – 5 3.3\times 10^{-5}用于口罩,0.029用于绘画).

blocks.en:
Neither the training budget nor a single texture seed explains the SonoSPADE lead.
We retrained CUT [ 36 ] and CycleGAN [ 14 ] , which the reference pipeline trains on 1,540 frames for 800 iterations, at SonoSPADE’s budget of 4,620 frames and 1,500 iterations, with an exponential moving average (EMA) of their weights.
With equal training budgets and three texture seeds per stage, the per-tissue stage gives a lower learned-mask base error than budget-matched CUT ( − 4.29 -4.29 mm [ − 6.57 -6.57 , − 2.00 -2.00 ]), CycleGAN ( − 4.01 -4.01 [ − 6.74 -6.74 , − 1.27 -1.27 ]) and physics ( − 4.28 -4.28 [ − 6.76 -6.76 , − 1.80 -1.80 ]).
All three meet the decision rule, each in 6/6 patients (paired t t p p 0.005 to 0.013; Holm p p 0.014 and exact sign-flip p p 0.031 each).
Raising CUT and CycleGAN to the per-tissue budget changes their learned-mask base error by + 0.37 +0.37 and + 0.07 +0.07 mm (secondary).
The policy rows of Table 4 still rest on one texture run per stage.
blocks.zh:
培训预算或单一的纹理种子都没有解释索诺SPADE领先.
我们重新训练了CUT [36] 和CycleGAN [14], 参考管道列车在1,540帧的800次重联上, 以索诺SPADE的预算为4,620帧和1,500次重联,
每期培训预算相等,种子有3个,因此,每期培训任务比预算相对应的CUT(−4.29-4.29毫米[−6.57-6.57,−2.00-2.00])、循环GAN(−4.01-4.01 [−6.74-6.74,−1.27-1.27])和物理(−4.28-4.28 [−6.76-6.76,−1.80-1.80])差。
这三个都符合决定规则,每6个病人(p.005至0.013;Holm p 0.014和准确的标志-flip p 0.031各1个)。
将 CUT 和 CycleGAN 提升到每个问题预算时,会改变它们学习到的掩码基差, + 0.37 + 0.37 和 + 0.07 + 0.07 mm(二级).
表4的政策行仍然停留在每阶段一次的纹理运行上。

blocks.en: 8.5 Replication cohorts
blocks.zh: 8.5 复制组

blocks.en:
The main contrasts of the six held-out patients recur on the 20 replication CTs, the mask and texture contrasts at about half their size.
With physics frames, the CT-mask and learned-mask servos end at 12.80 and 15.36 mm on these CTs.
These 20 cases come from the same public dataset (16 of 20 from institute E); this is internal replication, not external validity.
On 20 new CTs, learned masks with the physics stage add 2.57 mm over CT masks ([ + 1.66 +1.66 , + 3.47 +3.47 ], 19/20, Holm p = 7.4 × 10 − 5 p=7.4\times 10^{-5} ; exploratory), replicating the CT-to-learned-mask gap.
This gap is about half the + 4.92 +4.92 mm, 5/6, of the six held-out patients.
Both gaps are measured on the default render, whose organ boundaries fall below its display window.
The physics segmenters reach Dice 0.50 to 0.53 for liver and 0.17 to 0.42 for kidney on held-out simulated frames (post hoc; Supplementary Table S2.9).
On real liver frames (Vitale holdout, AUL), they reach 0.58 to 0.69 and SonoSPADE’s 0.40 to 0.58; on KidneyUS kidney, 0.35.
Each held-out simulated frame carries its own domain-randomization draw, so none is the default render.
On 20 new CTs, the per-tissue stage gives a lower learned-mask base error than physics ( − 2.04 -2.04 mm [ − 2.75 -2.75 , − 1.33 -1.33 ], 17/20, Holm p = 7.4 × 10 − 5 p=7.4\times 10^{-5} ; exploratory).
This lead is about half the − 4.06 -4.06 mm, 5/6, of the six held-out patients (Fig. 3 b).
On 20 new CTs, REINFORCE fine-tuning changes the final error by less than 1 mm in every policy arm (TOST, intersection-union, Holm p = 7.4 × 10 − 5 p=7.4\times 10^{-5} ; exploratory).
Applied post hoc to the six held-out patients, a TOST at the same margin shows equivalence in 8 of 8 policy configurations, but the crossed patient-by-seed interval with CUT frames and learned masks reaches + 1.18 +1.18 mm (Supplementary Table S2.7).
The intersection-union form of the cohort test was fixed when this post hoc result on the six held-out patients was already known.
The rung and stage ordering of the original six recurs on 20 new CTs (100% of the 40 rule-holding pairs keep their sign; Kendall τ b = 0.61 \tau_{b}=0.61 [0.45, 0.82]).
On 20 new CTs, the servo base under CT masks ends 11.17 mm farther from the target than the privileged pose oracle (oracle-to-CT-mask gap; exploratory).
On 20 new CTs, privileged look-ahead ascent on the CT-mask match score (a privileged reference rung) ends below the servo base by 4.96 mm [3.68, 6.23] (exploratory).
Both meet the cohort decision rule, with the same sign in 20/20 CTs (exact sign-flip p = 1.9 × 10 − 6 p=1.9\times 10^{-6} ; Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ).
Both are conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue.
This bound uses look-ahead sampling seed 0, as pre-specified.
With sampling seeds 0 to 2 averaged, it ends at 7.51 mm, 5.13 mm [3.87, 6.39] below the servo base (20/20; exploratory; estimation only; conditional on this renderer; Supplementary S7).

对6名被扣留的病人临时应用后,一个位于相同距离的TOST显示在8个政策配置中的8个中等效,但带CUT帧和学习过的口罩的逐种子间隔达到+1.18+1.18毫米(补充表S2.7).

blocks.en:
A second cohort of 30 CTs from the public AMOS 2022 dataset [ 71 ] , with TotalSegmentator v2 labels checked against its manual organ labels and every trained artifact unchanged, replicates the same contrasts ( B.9 ).
Learned masks with the physics stage add 4.01 mm over CT masks (29/30), SonoSPADE frames give the learned-mask servo base a lower error than physics frames ( − 2.73 -2.73 mm, 27/30), REINFORCE fine-tuning changes the final error by less than 1 mm in every policy configuration, and the ordering of rungs and stages recurs.
This is external replication in simulation only: CT source and label source change together, and no AMOS result speaks to real ultrasound.
Whether TotalSegmentator v2 was trained on AMOS images is not recorded, so the labels are treated as in-sample predictions; no artifact of the testbed was trained on an AMOS CT.
On 30 AMOS CTs, the servo base under CT masks ends 10.68 mm farther from the target than the privileged pose oracle (oracle-to-CT-mask gap; exploratory).
On 30 AMOS CTs, privileged look-ahead ascent on the CT-mask match score (a privileged reference rung) ends below the servo base by 4.51 mm [3.74, 5.29] (exploratory).
Both hold in 30/30 CTs, with Monte Carlo sign-flip p = 1.0 × 10 − 6 p=1.0\times 10^{-6} (1,000,000 sign vectors, seed 0) and Holm p = 2.0 × 10 − 6 p=2.0\times 10^{-6} .
Both are conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue.
This bound uses look-ahead sampling seed 0, as pre-specified.
With sampling seeds 0 to 2 averaged, it ends at 7.40 mm, 4.77 mm [4.05, 5.49] below the servo base (29/30; exploratory; estimation only; conditional on this renderer; Supplementary S7). B.9 reports, as estimation only, a relabeling control on the 20 replication CTs, a comparison of the two cohorts and the secondary results.
