blocks.en: 8.6 Offline evaluation on real frames
blocks.zh: 8.6 实际框架的离线评价

blocks.en:
On public real frames, a classifier distinguishes every texture stage from real images, and selection by the match score gives small organ-overlap gains for some combinations of stage, dataset and organ; this offline check uses no probe, phantom or robot.
The check does not show directed control on real frames (Table 8 ).
Against 60 annotated public frames [ 15 ] that no stage trained on, the two-sample classifier’s AUC [ 69 ] is 0.701 for CUT, 0.753 for CycleGAN, 0.936 for physics and 0.979 for SonoSPADE (Table 6 ).
In a post hoc label-permutation null with 200 permutations per stage, the AUC averages 0.50 (SD 0.07) and never reaches the observed value of any stage ( p = 1 / 201 p=1/201 each; Supplementary Table S2.16).
The physics renderer is closer to real than the authors’ reimplementation of LOTUS, with a pooled W1 of 0.0727 against 0.1272 and a lower W1 in 6/6 patients.
In a post hoc comparison, the physics renderer’s W1 is also below that of the original LOTUS code, 0.0875, pooled and in 5/6 patients.
This W1 is sensitive to display settings, because one domain-randomization draw per view lowers it to 0.0154.
The 0.77 sector compression of Section 3.4 enters every real-frame metric and the matched-layout ceiling, the median IoU, 0.56, of 60 real frames against their best-matching held-out CT views.
No stage is called realistic.
Organ identity counts the scored organs whose most frequent predicted class is correct in both domains.
It shows no difference detected across stages on all 60 Vitale frames and on the 18 holdout frames (not powered for equivalence; Table 7 ).
blocks.zh:
在公共真实的帧上,一个分类器将每个纹理阶段与真实的图像区分开来,通过匹配分数的选择,会给舞台,数据集和器官的某些组合带来小的器官重叠增益;这种离线检查没有使用探测器,幻象或机器人.
该检查没有显示对真实框架的直接控制(表8)。
与60个没有经过培训的附加说明的公共框架[15]相比,两个抽样分类器的AUC[69]是CUT的0.701,循环GAN的0.753,物理的0.936和SonoSPADE的0.979(表6)。
在一个带有200个每个阶段的排气量的后期标签加压中,AUC平均为0.50(SD 0.07),从未达到任何阶段的观测值(p=1/201p=1/201;补充表S2.16)。
物理渲染器比作者重新执行LOTUS更接近真实,集合W1为0.0727对0.1272,6/6患者的W1更低.
在一次事后的比较中,物理渲染器的W1也低于最初的LOTUS代码,0.0875,集合和5/6患者.
这款W1对显示设置很敏感,因为每个视图有一个域随机图画将其降低到0.0154.
第3.4节的0.77扇区压缩输入每个实际框架的度量衡和匹配的上限,即60个实际框架的中间IoU,0.56,与其最佳匹配的CT视图相对应。
没有舞台叫现实。
器官身份计算得分的器官,这两个领域最经常预测的类别是正确的。
这表明,在所有60个维他命框架和18个搁置框架(无对等电源;表7)上,各阶段都没有发现差异。

blocks.en: Table 8 : Outcomes of the real-frame cells of SonoSPADE, the standard engine’s texture stage (all eight testable cells, with the ladder’s other texture settings: Table 9 ). Keep-best gain: primary gain over the static start (Table 8 ). Selection: organ IoU of the state the match score selects along undirected motion, minus that of a random state. Directed control: the policy’s keep-best gain minus that of magnitude-matched undirected motion with the same selection. Values: exploratory per-subject IoU means [95% subject-by-CT bootstrap CI]. A cell holds if its CI excludes 0 and its Holm p p over eight cells is below 0.05. In the holding cell, 38/55 subjects share the sign; exact sign-flip p = 3.4 × 10 − 4 p=3.4\times 10^{-4} and Holm p = 0.003 p=0.003 . Elsewhere Holm p p is 0.055 to 1.000.
blocks.zh: 表8: SonoSPADE,标准引擎的纹理级(所有8个可测试的细胞,带有阶梯的其他纹理设置:表9)的真帧细胞的结果. 保持最佳收益:静态启动后的主要收益(表8)。 选择: 状态的机关 IoU 比赛分数按照未定向的运动来选择,减去随机状态. 定向控制:保单保持最佳收益减去以相同选择进行量级比的无定向运动。 值:每个主体IoU的探索性表示[95%的主体逐CT靴CI]. 如果一个囚室的CI排除0,并且其 超过8个细胞在0.05以下 在羁留室中,38/55对象共用标志;准确的标志-flip p=3.4×10−4 p=3.4\times 10×4}和霍尔姆p=0.003 p=0.003. 在别处 Holm p是0.055到1000. (英语).

blocks.en:
The reward, computed on real frames, moves the simulated view toward the real target’s organ layout for liver, and for kidney with SonoSPADE on KidneyUS.
Elsewhere there is no reliable improvement on real targets, including every stage on the 4 Vitale kidney targets.
Keep-best gains over the static start have CIs above 0 in 7 of 16 combinations (Table 8 ), and physics on KidneyUS kidney falls, at − 0.014 -0.014 [ − 0.026 -0.026 , − 0.001 -0.001 ].
Under a post hoc bootstrap crossed over targets, CTs and seeds, only SonoSPADE on Vitale-holdout liver keeps a CI above 0, and none also meets a Holm-adjusted t t -test (Supplementary S2).
Absolute keep-best IoU is 0.303 to 0.344 on Vitale-holdout liver and 0.144 to 0.186 on KidneyUS kidney [ 73 ] , against a matched-layout ceiling of 0.56 (exploratory).
Final-step gains are − 0.073 -0.073 to − 0.031 -0.031 on KidneyUS kidney, negative for all four stages, and + 0.016 +0.016 to + 0.050 +0.050 on Vitale-holdout liver (exploratory).
Real-side units are frames or file-stem groups of unknown patient identity and may not be independent.
blocks.zh:
根据真实框架计算出的奖励将模拟视野移向肝脏和肾脏的真正目标器官布局。
在其他地方,在实际目标方面没有可靠的改进,包括4维塔利肾目标的每个阶段。
静态起始时保持最佳收益的CI在16种组合中的7种中高于0(表8),肾脏上的物理学下降至0.014-0.014 [0.026-0.026,−0.001-0.001]。
在一个越过目标、CT和种子的后临时靴子下,只有维塔勒控肝脏上的SonoSPADE将CI维持在0以上,也没有一个达到Holm调整 t - t测试(补充S2)。
绝对保持最佳IoU在Vitale-holdout肝脏上为0.303至0.344,肾脏上为0.144至0.186[73],而配电上限为0.56(勘探)。
肾脏的末级增益为-0.073-0.73至-0.031-0.31,所有四个阶段均呈负数,而维他命控肝脏(勘探)的增益为+0.016+0.016+0.050+0.050。
Real-side单位是不明患者身份的帧或文件样板组,可能不独立.

blocks.en: 9 Discussion
blocks.zh: 9 讨论情况

blocks.en: 9.1 Principal findings
blocks.zh: 9.1 主要调查结果

blocks.en:
The answer to the research question is no: in this testbed, published components plugged one slot at a time did not close the gap to the pose oracle.
Without privileged input, no level of the ladder succeeded at 5 mm and 5 ∘ in over 5.6% of episodes (post hoc).
Among controllers, only the DAgger residual separated from its base ( − 3.17 -3.17 mm, 6/6; Section 7.2 ), a base not detectably closer than the start.
In the primary analysis, most of the error ( + 10.1 +10.1 to + 10.3 +10.3 mm, 6/6) lies between the pose oracle and the CT-mask servo.
The oracle-to-CT-mask gap is not attributed to one cause (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
The CT-to-learned-mask gap is the second limit, at + 4.80 +4.80 to + 5.26 +5.26 mm for three of four stages on the nearly isoechoic default render.
Across the engine’s texture settings, the smaller CT-to-learned-mask gap went with label access, not with distance to real frames by KID.
As the label-painted control of Section 8.4 shows, label access is a property of the engine’s texture stage, not of one method.
blocks.zh:
对研究问题的答案是否定的:在这个试验台中,已公布的组件一次插上一个插槽,并没有将空隙关闭到姿势甲骨文.
没有特权的输入,在超过5.6%的剧集(后临时)中,没有5毫米和5QQ的梯级成功.
在控制器中,只有Dagger残基与其基座分离(−3.17-3.17毫米,6/6;第7.2节),一个基座无法探测到比起始点更接近.
在主分析中,大部分误差(+10.1+10.1至+10.3+10.3毫米,6/6)位于姿势甲骨文和CT-mask servo之间.
甲骨文对-CT-mask间隙不归于一个原因(在这个渲染器上的条件:网格固定的光谱,无高架束宽度,刚性组织).
CT-to-learning-mask间隙是第二个限制,在接近异构默认渲染的4个阶段中的3个阶段为+4.80+4.80至+5.26+5.26毫米。
在引擎的纹理设置中, 较小的 CT 到 learning- mask 间隙带有标签访问权限, 而不是 KID 与真实框架的距离 。
正如第8.4节的标签涂版控制所示,标签访问是发动机纹理阶段的财产,而不是一种方法。

blocks.en: 9.2 Using the testbed and reporting new methods
blocks.zh: 9.2 国家 使用试验床和报告新方法

blocks.en:
Unlike hardware tests [ 22 , 24 ] , USB Gym compares components slot by slot against privileged references, in simulation only.
A new method can be reported as in Table 5 , from at least three training seeds with the patient-by-seed interval of B .
One new reference seed is expected within ± 1.34 \pm 1.34 mm of the seed mean (95% prediction interval; Section 8.1 ).
At n = 6 n=6 , a plugged method’s result is an estimate with its interval, read beside coverage and cost, not a ranking.
Of 19 contrasts in the guide’s slots, 15 showed no detectable difference; the task remains under-explored.
blocks.zh:
不同于硬件测试 [22, 24], USB Gym将组件槽逐个档次与特权引用比较,仅模拟.
新方法可如表5所示,从至少三个训练种子中报告,患者的种子间隔为B。
预计在每颗种子平均值1.34 ppm 1.34 mm(95%的预测间隔;第8.1节)以内将有一个新的参考种子。
在 n = 6 n = 6 时,插值法的结果是其间隔的估计数,读作覆盖率和成本,而不是排名。
在指南的19个档次中,15个没有可察觉的差别;任务仍未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: 9.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9.3 限制

blocks.en:
USB Gym cannot show how tissue deforms under pressure or whether a rendered frame looks real.
Deformable ultrasound simulation [ 74 , 75 , 76 ] offers a route to pressure-dependent images.
By default, the renderer has grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width and a nearly isoechoic default.
The reference renderer was compared with no physical phantom, only with the original LOTUS code, SIMUS and digital phantom bands.
The real-frame results score the reward offline, so we claim no sim-to-real transfer of a policy.
blocks.zh:
美国B 健身无法显示组织在压力下是如何变形的,也无法显示一个制成的框架看起来是否真实.
可变形的超声模拟[74,75,76]提供了通向依赖压力的图像的路径.
默认情况下,渲染器有网格固定的光谱,无高架束宽度和近异构默认.
参考渲染器被比作没有物理幻象,只有原始的LOTUS代码,SIMUS和数字幻象波段.
真正框架的结果得分是离线的,因此我们声称一项政策没有实际转移。

blocks.en:
Every absolute error and success rate is conditional on the target-anchored contact plane, one per target window and normal to its beam.
The skin-tangent contact plane lies near the target window, so contact still carries target information (Section 8.3 ); deformable contact with the CT skin itself could remove this dependence.
Under the servo base and pose oracle, the probe lags its command by 1.3 to 1.5 mean commanded steps (post hoc; Supplementary Table S2.12).
Neither the contact nor the actuation model has been validated against a robot.
The loop models no respiration, arm kinematics, tracking noise, contact force in the observation or loss of gel coupling.
blocks.zh:
每个绝对误差和成功率都以目标安抚的接触平面为条件,每个目标窗口一个,并正常到它的梁.
皮肤质接触平面位于目标窗口附近,因此接触仍然带有目标信息(第8.3节);与CT皮肤本身的变形接触可以消除这种依赖.
在伺服器基座和姿势甲骨文下,探测器的指挥滞后了1.3至1.5个平均指令步骤(后特设;补充表S2.12).
无论是接触还是激活模型都没有对机器人进行验证.
循环模型没有呼吸,臂动,跟踪噪声,在凝胶耦合的观察中接触力或丢失.

blocks.en:
Without tuning, no result ranks a method beyond this configuration or for clinical use.
The reward weights, the action cost and the DR ranges were set by hand and never varied, and the DR landscape has intervals over three segmenter seeds only (post hoc).
The learned-mask controller experiment removes privileged input from the controller and mask source only (Section 7.2 ).
The v2 relabeling ( B.6 ) uses TotalSegmentator’s own training CTs, so it likely understates an independent segmenter’s label noise.
In the AMOS CTs, CT source and label source change together (Section 8.5 ).
Every result was computed on one Apple-silicon laptop.
Evaluating the learned-mask servo base on the CPU instead of the laptop’s GPU changes a patient’s final error by up to 0.22 mm (physics stage, seed 0; exploratory), more than the smallest reported differences, so small contrasts should be compared on one device.
blocks.zh:
没有调音,结果就无法将一种方法排在这种配置之外或用于临床。
奖励权重,动作成本和DR范围是手工设定的,从未变异过,DR地貌的间隔只有三片种子(后临时).
学习-掩码控制器实验从控制器中去除特权输入,仅遮罩来源(第7.2节.
v2重贴标签(B.6)使用TotalSegmentator自己的训练CT,因此很可能低估了独立片段者的标签噪声.
在AMOS CTs中,CT源和标签源一起改变(第8.5节)。
每个结果都用一台苹果硅电脑计算。
评估CPU上的学习-mask服务器基础,而不是笔记本电脑的GPU将病人的最终误差改变为0.22毫米(物理阶段,种子0;探索性),比所报告的最小差异还要多,因此在一个设备上应该比较小的对比.

blocks.en:
SonoSPADE [ 4 ] comes from our group and was used unchanged, so the comparisons against it are not independent of its authors.
The guide’s slots were compared on the standard engine only, whose SonoSPADE frames carry label information (Section 8.4 ).
blocks.zh:
SonoSPADE [4]来自我们集团,使用时没有改变,因此与它的比较并不独立于它的作者.
在标准引擎上只比较了指南的插槽,其SonoSPADE帧带有标签信息(第8.4节)。

blocks.en: 10 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 10. 结论

blocks.en:
Plugged one slot at a time, untuned and at the reference training budget, existing published components did not close the gap to the pose oracle in this simulator.
The guide was compared on the standard simulation engine, a physics renderer with the SonoSPADE texture stage, which stays pluggable.
To test the testbed, the combination of slot components chosen on six held-out patients, our pipeline with an SSIM reward term, was tested on 20 new CTs.
On the standard engine, it was the benchmark baseline, at 13.70 mm (pose oracle 1.47 mm; exploratory; conditional on this renderer).
Its 0.26 mm lead over our reference pipeline lies within ± 1 \pm 1 mm and is not attributed to SSIM (Section 7.4 ).
Of 19 contrasts in the guide’s slots, 4 differed detectably and 15 did not, 2 of these within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (post hoc) and 13 inconclusive at n = 6 n=6 (exploratory).
The task therefore remains under-explored, with much room for research.
The testbed accepts new components in each slot.
No policy ran on hardware, so a phantom or robot test is the next step.
blocks.zh:
一次插一个插槽,未调和,在参考培训预算中,现有已公布的组件没有弥合这个模拟器中与姿势甲骨文的差距.
该指南在标准模拟引擎上进行了比较,该引擎是SonoSPADE纹理级的物理渲染器,可保持插件状态.
为了测试试床,在6名被搁置的病人身上选择的槽组件组合,我们的管道有一个SSIM奖励期,在20个新的CT上进行了测试.
在标准发动机上,它是基准基线,为13.70毫米(有甲骨文1.47毫米;探索性;以这个渲染器为条件).
它在我们参考管道上的0.26毫米铅位于±1\pm 1毫米范围内,不归于SSIM(第7.4节)。
在指南的19个档次中,有4个有明显差异,15个没有,其中2个在±1 ppm 1毫米(临时后)内,13个在n=6 n=6(勘探)时没有定论。
因此,这项任务仍然没有得到充分探讨,研究的余地很大。
测试台接受每个槽中的新组件.
没有政策运行在硬件上, 所以幽灵或机器人测试是下一步。

blocks.zh: 数据和软件的可用性

blocks.en:
Software. The code, tests and documentation are public at https://github.com/tohnperfect/USBGym under the Apache License 2.0.
Zenodo archives every release [ 5 ] under the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23942190 , which resolves to the latest; that release’s scripts/paper folder rebuilds every table and figure data file of the article and the supplement from the result files below and compares each with the printed one, except the figure data that need the texture-network checkpoints or the Vitale frames, which the result files leave out.
Every printed number can be recomputed from it, and retraining reproduces a result only within the training variability of Section 8.1 .
The segmenter training code is in the segtrain folder of the code repository.
A second Zenodo record [ 77 ] holds the result files behind every table, under DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23913142 . C lists every plugged method of each slot from these files (Table 1 ).

blocks.en:
Data. All data behind the results come from public datasets.
CT anatomy, including the 20 replication CTs, comes from the TotalSegmentator dataset [ 3 ] under CC BY 4.0.
The 30 CTs of the external cohort come from AMOS 2022 [ 71 ] .
Its dataset description states CC BY-SA 4.0 and its Zenodo record CC BY 4.0, so any derivative is released, if at all, under CC BY-SA 4.0 with attribution.
Real abdominal frames come from the public Kaggle set of Vitale et al. [ 15 ] , whose page reserves the data files to their original authors and asks users to cite [ 15 ] .
Real kidney frames come from KidneyUS [ 73 ] under CC BY-NC-SA .
Its maintainers grant access only after registration and manual approval.
Segmenter weights trained on KidneyUS are not released; the segtrain folder of the code repository retrains them from the datasets above.
Real liver frames come from the Annotated Ultrasound Liver dataset [ 78 , 79 ] under CC BY 4.0.
The liver frames, the KidneyUS holdout split and a group-disjoint Vitale holdout serve only as real targets.
Fig. 3 reproduces frames of the public Vitale set [ 80 ] .

blocks.en: A.1 Case split and reference texture stages

blocks.en:
The 13 training cases are s0011, s0058, s0344, s0461, s0477, s0511, s0522, s0703, s0720, s0727, s0777, s1086 and s1373.
The six held-out cases are s0358, s0513, s0519, s0591, s0649 and s0762.
Supplementary S5 lists the window screens (Supplementary Table S5.1), the gel coupling and the start lift.
Fig. 1 , cited in Section 3.4 , shows one held-out view under the four reference texture stages.
blocks.zh: 第3.4节引用的图1显示了在四个参考纹理阶段下的一种坚持观点。

blocks.en: Figure 1 : What the testbed renders: one held-out view under the four reference texture stages, from patient s0513 at the target pose of its first screened liver window (top) and kidney window (bottom). Left: the CT label map, with orange liver, green gallbladder, blue vessel, pink kidney and gray other tissue. Physics: the sector-warped render without domain randomization and with a fixed speckle seed, in which liver and surrounding tissue are nearly isoechoic (Section 3.4 ). CUT, CycleGAN and SonoSPADE act on that frame, and SonoSPADE also receives the label map. Supplementary Fig. S3.1 shows the same patient under the renderer-slot simulators. The figure is qualitative.
blocks.zh: 图1:试验床在四个参考纹理阶段下产生的结果:从病人s0513到其第一个筛选的肝窗(顶部)和肾窗(底部)的目标姿势。 左:CT标签图,有橙色肝脏,绿色胆囊,蓝色容器,粉红色肾脏和灰色其他组织. 物理学:无域随机化的扇形成型,并有固定的斑点种子,其中肝脏和周围组织几乎是异质的(第3.4节)。 CUT,CycleGAN和SonoSPADE在该帧上行动,SonoSPADE也收到标签地图. 补充图。 S3.1在渲染槽模拟器下显示同样的病人. 这一数字是定性的。

blocks.en: A.2 Details of the controls
blocks.zh: A.2 控制的细节

blocks.en: All results of this subsection are exploratory; they complete the controls that Sections 6 and 8 and Table 7 summarize.
blocks.zh: 这一小节的所有结果都是探索性的;它们完成了第6和8节以及表7概述的控制。

blocks.en:
Two of the four comparisons use the hill-climb, a pose-free controller that keeps a random step only when the match score rises.
The CT-mask servo base reads only CT label slices, so an independent target speckle field leaves it unchanged by construction.
With a target speckle field independent of the observation’s, the learned-mask servo base changes by − 0.63 -0.63 mm [ − 2.04 -2.04 , + 0.78 +0.78 ] (secondary).
With a target speckle field independent of the observation’s, the hill-climb under CT masks changes by + 0.05 +0.05 mm [ − 0.13 -0.13 , + 0.24 +0.24 ] (secondary).
With a target speckle field independent of the observation’s, the hill-climb under learned masks changes by − 0.14 -0.14 mm [ − 0.71 -0.71 , + 0.42 +0.42 ] (secondary).
blocks.zh:
4个比较中的2个采用山地-攀登(英语:Hill-climb),1个不设姿势的控制器,仅在比赛分数上升时才保持随机步骤.
CT-mask servo基部只读取CT标签切片,因此一个独立的目标Speckle场通过构造使其不变.
利用独立于观测的目标Speckle场,学习-面具伺服器基数变化−0.63-0.63毫米[−2.04-2.04,+0.78+0.78](二级).
CT口罩下的山丘-爬升板具有独立于观测范围的目标光谱场,变化为+0.05+0.05毫米[−0.13-0.13,+0.24+0.24](二级).
利用独立于观测范围的目标光谱场,学习过的口罩下的山丘-爬行变化为−0.14-0.14毫米[−0.71-0.71,+0.42+0.42](次).

At 36 steps, privileged look-ahead ascent on the CT-mask match score ends below the 36-step servo base by 13.36 mm [9.20, 17.52] (6/6; exploratory, look-ahead seed 0 only).

With learned masks and the physics stage, poses 5 mm or more from the target score within 0.01 of the target’s own score for 6/60 targets (0/6 patients with a majority; margin 0.056 [0.035, 0.076]).
With learned masks and the CUT stage, poses 5 mm or more from the target score within 0.01 of the target’s own score for 9/60 targets (0/6 patients with a majority; margin 0.056 [0.043, 0.070]).

blocks.en:
The gap-cause test was also run with a second imaging plane, the probe pose turned 90 ∘ about its beam axis: each plane is scored against its own target plane, and the score is the mean of the two (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
It repeats the CT-mask level set, searched at 2, 5 and 10 mm and read at 5 mm, and privileged look-ahead ascent, the bound of the test, at look-ahead seed 0 and 12 steps, both with this score.
With a second, orthogonal imaging plane, 0/6 patients are ambiguous at 5 mm (single plane: 0/6), and the bound ends at 5.75 mm (exploratory).
The bound is a privileged reference, not a bound on other controllers.
blocks.zh:
空隙-因子测试也用第二个成像平面进行,探测器的姿势在它的光束轴上转90 ∘:每个平面对准自己的目标平面得分,得分是两者的平均值(在这个渲染器上的条件:网格固定的光谱,没有高架光束宽度,刚性组织).
它重复了CT-mask级别设定,以2,5和10毫米搜索和5毫米读取,以及特权外观-ahead上方,测试的极限,在外观-ahead种子0和12步,都以这个分数.
使用第二,正交成像平面,0/6患者在5毫米(单平面:0/6)时模棱两可,绑定端为5.75毫米(探索).
约束是一种特权的参考,而不是对其他控制器的约束.

blocks.en:
The gap-cause test was also run with speckle fixed to tissue on a 0.23 mm lattice, with observation and target sharing one anchored field or drawing independent ones (estimation only; Supplementary S7).
Every result of this paragraph under the anchored mode is conditional on this renderer with tissue-anchored speckle: no elevational beam width, rigid tissue.
With no elevational beam width, the speckle of one field changes completely within about one lattice spacing of out-of-plane motion.
With speckle anchored to tissue, 0/6 patients are ambiguous at 5 mm and the bound ends at 8.77 mm (exploratory).
With the target drawn from an independent anchored field, so that speckle carries no match information, 0/6 patients are ambiguous at 5 mm and the bound ends at 8.26 mm.
With grid-fixed speckle, 0/6 were ambiguous and the bound ended at 8.55 mm, and the independent-field bound ends 0.30 mm [ − 0.57 -0.57 , 1.17] below it (2/6; exploratory; estimation only; Supplementary S7).
This variant assigns no gap-cause class, and the class stays mixed.
Supplementary S7 gives the level-set margins and the contrasts of both bounds with the servo base and the pose oracle.
blocks.zh:
缝隙引起的试验还用0.23毫米宽的丝网固定在组织上,观测和目标共用一个锚场或绘制独立的场(仅估计;补充S7)。
该款在锚定模式下的每一结果都取决于这种带有组织焦虑的光谱的成形器:无高梁宽度,刚性组织.
在没有高架束宽的情况下,一个场的光谱在飞机外运动的大约一个直径范围内完全改变。
由于Speckle锚定在组织上,0/6患者在5毫米时模棱两可,绑定端在8.77毫米时模棱两可(探索性).
由于目标从一个独立的锚地中抽取,使得Speckle没有匹配信息,0/6患者在5毫米时模棱两可,绑定者在8.26毫米时模棱两可.
使用网格固定的光谱,0/6模棱两可,约束结束为8.55毫米,独立场约束结束为0.30毫米[−0.57-0.57,1.17],低于它(2/6;探索性;仅估算;补充S7].
此变体指定无间隙-原因类,类保持混合.
补充S7给出了水平设置的边距和两者与伺服基和姿势甲骨文的对比.

blocks.en:
Under CT masks with physics frames, the gap-cause test also scored each pose against a target that shares the observation’s speckle field.
Scoring against a target that shares the observation’s speckle field raises the score at 98.1% of the 229,631 scored poses (smallest shared minus independent − 0.0105 -0.0105 ; mean + 0.0043 +0.0043 ).
With it, the largest score 5 mm or more away is 0.924, against 1.000 at the target (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
blocks.zh:
在带有物理框架的 CT 口罩下, 空隙-因为测试还得分了每个对一个共享观测光谱场的目标的姿势。
在229,631个得分的阵容(最小的共享减独立-0.0105-0.0105;平均值+0.0043+0.0043)中,通过对目标进行分计,将得分提高到98.1%。
有了它,5毫米或更远的最大得分是0.924,而目标为1000(这个渲染器上的条件:网格固定的光谱,无高梁宽度,刚性组织).

blocks.en:
Hill-climbing on the match score does not end below the servo base within 12 steps under either mask source.
Supplementary S7 gives three further pose-free rungs and, beyond physics frames, the hill-climb under the other three texture stages (estimation only).
blocks.zh:
比赛成绩的希尔攀登不会在12步内在两个面具来源下结束于服务器基底.
补充S7给出了另外三个无姿势突起,在物理框架之外,其他三个纹理阶段下的丘陵爬行(仅估计).

blocks.en:
The base fit refits the servo base to the analytic twist per channel on 500 fresh pairs of training patients and 500 held-out pairs.
It reads R 2 of 0.2 to 0.5 as partly and below 0.2 as barely predicting.
Channels vx to wz are the lateral, elevational and axial translations, then the rotations about those axes.
Under CT masks, on held-out pairs the servo base partly predicts wy (R 2 0.31 to 0.41; fresh TRAIN pairs 0.37 to 0.38) and its gains shrink to b = 0.32 to 0.39.
It barely predicts vx, vy, vz, wx and wz (held-out R 2 at most 0.13; fresh TRAIN pairs at most 0.17), and its gains on them shrink to b = − 0.03 -0.03 to 0.18.
Under learned masks, on held-out pairs the servo base barely predicts all six channels (R 2 − 0.188 -0.188 to 0.198; fresh TRAIN pairs − 0.091 -0.091 to 0.240) and its gains shrink to b = − 0.03 -0.03 to 0.25.
Supplementary S7 repeats this fit for a servo base whose map is a multilayer perceptron and for the servo base under learned masks with the other three texture stages (estimation only).
blocks.zh:
该基地在500对新鲜的训练病人和500对被扣留的病人上,将服务基地重新配对到每个通道的分析扭矩.
它将0.2至0.5的R 2读作部分和低于0.2,几乎无法预测.
声道vx至wz是横向,高架和轴式的翻译,然后是这些轴的旋转.
在CT口罩下,在被搁置的对子上,伺服器基部部分预测wy(R 2 0.31至0.41;新鲜的TRAIN对0.37至0.38),其收益缩到b = 0.32至0.39.
它几乎无法预测vx,vy,vz,wx和wz(持有-out R 2,最多0.13;新鲜的TRAIN对,最多0.17),它的增益缩小到b= - 0.03 - 0.03到0.18.
在有学识的口罩下,在搁置的对联上,伺服器基地几乎无法预测所有六个信道(R 2 - 0.188 - 0.188 - 0.198;新鲜的列车对联 - 0.091 - 0.091 - 0.240),其收益缩到b = - 0.03 - 0.03 - 0.25。
补充S7重复这个适合用于一个Servo基座,其地图是多层感应器,以及用于Servo基座在学习的口罩下与其他三个纹理阶段(仅估计).

blocks.en: In the exploratory 36-step experiment, the post hoc keep-best error of the CT-mask servo base is 10.30 mm, against a final error of 18.34 mm (Table 1 ; Supplementary Table S2.13 splits the error by axis at 0, 12 and 36 steps).
blocks.zh: 在探索性36步实验中,CT-mask伺服器基座的后临时保存最佳误差为10.30毫米,最终误差为18.34毫米(表1;补充表S2.13将误差分为0,12和36步).

Fig. 2 plots the mean translation error against the control step for the static start, the pose oracle and the CT-mask and learned-mask servos (post hoc).
Supplementary Tables S2.1 to S2.3 give the rotation error, success rate and match score of every level, the split by target organ and the error at each step.
blocks.zh:
图2. 对照控制步骤绘制静态启动、姿势甲骨文和CT-mask和学习-mask服务器(特设后)的均匀翻译错误。

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Mean translation error against control step on the six held-out patients, with contact on and no domain randomization at evaluation (post hoc). Lines show the static start, the pose oracle, the CT-mask servo base and final policies, and the learned-mask final policies. The CT-mask servos improve up to step 12, while three learned-mask policies are lowest at step 4 or 5 and then drift away. Supplementary Fig. S2.1 shows each patient’s final error on every rung.
Every contrast is conditional on the trained artifacts (texture networks, segmenters, bases and policies). Seeds index artifacts; the patient is the sampling unit.
blocks.zh:
图2:对照6名被扣留病人的控制步骤,在评价时有接触且没有域随机化(事后临时)的平均值翻译错误。 线条显示静态起始,姿势甲骨文,CT-mask服务器基础和最终政策,以及学习-mask最终政策. CT-mask服务器改进到第12步,而3个学习的mask政策在第4或第5步最低,然后漂移. 补充图。 S2.1显示每个病人在每个跑道上的最后错误。
每一种对比都取决于训练有素的文物(纹理网络、支架、基地和政策)。 种子索引文物;患者为采样单位.

blocks.en:
The painted stage sets the kidney echogenicity from the published normal hepatorenal index [ 72 ] , draws a 12 dB capsule line as a design constant and leaves organs without a published quantitative ratio at the physics level; its effect counts as reproduced only if a TOST at ± 1 \pm 1 mm passes.
The painted stage’s segmenters reach a held-out simulated Dice of 0.56 to 0.63, and a real-frame Dice of 0.35 to 0.71 on liver and 0.37 to 0.40 on kidney.
Against real frames, the painted stage has a W1 of 0.083, a KID of 0.205 and a C2ST AUC of 0.942, against 0.073, 0.220 and 0.936 for physics frames.
No stage is called realistic.
blocks.zh:
涂装阶段从公布的正常肝脏指数[72]中设置肾回波成因,绘制12 dB胶囊线作为设计常数,使器官在物理水平上没有公布的定量比;其效果只有在 ± 1\pm 1 mm 的 TOST 过关时才会被复制.
所画舞台的分层器可达到0.56至0.63的悬浮模拟骰子和0.35至0.71的肝脏和0.37至0.40的肾脏真帧骰子。
相对于真实的帧,所绘舞台的W1为0.083,KID为0.205,C2ST AUC为0.942,物理帧为0.073,0.220和0.936.
没有舞台叫现实。

blocks.en:
The window screen passed 11 of 12 thorax-abdomen-pelvis, 8 of 11 polytrauma, 5 of 6 neck-thorax-abdomen-pelvis and 5 of 5 whole-body studies.
The 20 accepted cases comprise 9, 6, 3 and 2 studies of these types.
blocks.zh:
窗屏经过12个胸腺-腹肌-骨盆中的11个,11个多创伤中的8个,6个颈腺-腹肌-骨盆中的5个,5个全身研究.
这20个被接受的案例包括9、6、3和2项这类研究。

blocks.en: A.3 Appearance-term learnability
blocks.zh: A.3 短期学习能力

blocks.en:
A.3 , A.4 and A.5 compare the four texture stages with task and windows held fixed.
The learnability and DR landscape results come from simulation alone.
Learnability is the Spearman correlation between the appearance term and closeness, the negative translation distance to the target, so a higher value means a more pose-sensitive term.
Each contrast uses Δ ​ z \Delta z , the per-patient difference in mean Fisher-transformed correlation, SonoSPADE minus the other stage.
blocks.zh:
A.3、A.4和A.5将四个纹理阶段与固定的任务和窗户进行比较。
可学习性和DR景观结果仅来自于模拟.
可学习性是外观名词和亲近性,负翻译距离目标之间的斯皮尔曼关联,所以更高的值意味着一个更注重姿势的名词.
每个对比使用 QQ z \ Delta z, 平均Fisher- transformed exploration 的每个病人差数, SonoSPADE 减去另一个阶段.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Appearance-term learnability on the 6 held-out patients. Each target view (5 per patient and organ, 60 in all) is compared with 40 nearby probe poses; the per-view score is the Spearman correlation between the sector-interior appearance match and closeness to the target pose. (a) SonoSPADE against each other stage: mean per-view Spearman of both stages, the mean over patients of the per-patient difference in mean Fisher- z z ( Δ ​ z \Delta z ), its 95% patient-cluster bootstrap CI, and the number of patients that share its sign. Rule: a difference under the CI-and-sign rule. The pooled rows are the pre-specified primary contrast. (b) Exploratory renderer-term ablation, not pre-specified: mean per-view Spearman with one renderer term switched off. Interface reflection off: no transmission loss or specular echo at tissue interfaces, attenuation kept. Diffuse scattering off: scattering strength 0. Depth variation of the PSF off: a depth-invariant lateral width. Flat means the appearance term is constant over poses, so the correlation is undefined. DR is off throughout.
blocks.zh: 表2:6名被滞留病人的短期学习能力。 每个目标视图(每个病人和器官5个,总共60个)与附近的40个探测姿势相比;每个视角的得分是扇形外观匹配与目标姿势接近之间的斯皮尔曼关联. blocks.en:
Per-tissue texture gives the most pose-sensitive appearance term of the four stages.
Pooled over organs, the mean correlation is 0.613 for SonoSPADE and 0.542 to 0.548 for physics, CUT and CycleGAN (Table 2 ; Supplementary Fig. S2.2 draws the landscape).
Against each of the three, Δ ​ z \Delta z is + 0.098 +0.098 to + 0.107 +0.107 , each CI excludes 0, and the sign agrees in 6/6 patients.
The CI-and-sign rule is also met within each organ, with Δ ​ z \Delta z of + 0.108 +0.108 to + 0.127 +0.127 for liver (6/6, 6/6 and 5/6 patients) and + 0.088 +0.088 to + 0.099 +0.099 for kidney (6/6 each).

An exploratory renderer-term ablation, not pre-specified, switches off one term of the physics renderer at a time and then all three (Table 2 , part b).
Switching off interface reflection or the depth variation of the PSF moves no mean correlation by more than 0.007.
Switching off diffuse scattering lowers physics to 0.476 and CycleGAN to 0.508, leaves CUT at 0.540 and raises SonoSPADE to 0.647.
With all three switched off, the appearance term of physics, CUT and CycleGAN is constant across poses.
SonoSPADE’s appearance term, whose input also includes the tissue-label slice, stays pose-sensitive at 0.641.
blocks.zh:
试探性渲染器期的切换,而不是预先指定的,一次切换一个物理渲染器的学期,然后全部切换三个学期(表2,b部分)。
关闭接口反射或PSF的深度变异,没有超过0.007的偶联关系.
将散射散射率降低到0.476,循环GAN为0.508,CUT为0.540,将SonoSPADE提高到0.647.
三个关机后,物理,CUT和CycleGAN的外观名词在姿势上保持不变.
SonoSPADE的外观术语,其输入还包括组织标签片,在0.641时保持姿势敏感.

blocks.en: A.4 DR knobs and the DR landscape
blocks.zh: A.4 DR把手和 DR 景观

blocks.en:
Table 3 lists each randomized render parameter with its range and the mean absolute in-sector pixel change at each end, in hundredths of the intensity range.
A full DR draw changes the frame by 13.61 to 14.76 for physics, CUT and CycleGAN and by 7.78 for SonoSPADE, against 6.40 to 8.00 for a 5 mm probe slide.
The overall gain and the impedance multiplier are nearly inert, changing it by at most 0.48 at either end of their ranges.
blocks.zh:
表3列出了每个随机化的渲染参数,其范围以及每端平均绝对区间像素变化,以强度范围的百分之一表示.
一个全DR绘图将框架修改为物理,CUT和CycleGAN的13.61至14.76,SonoSPADE的7.78,而5毫米探测器滑翔的6.40至8.00.
整体增益和障碍乘数几乎是惰性的,在幅度的两端最多改变0.48。

blocks.en:
The DR landscape repeats the learnability measurement with DR off, with one draw shared by target and samples, with independent draws for each, and with a new speckle seed only.
Under independent draws, the appearance term’s mean correlation falls from 0.542–0.548 to 0.320–0.327 for physics, CUT and CycleGAN and from 0.613 to 0.508 for SonoSPADE.
With a new speckle seed only, it stays within 0.005 of the DR-off value, so the speckle seed alone does not explain the drop.
blocks.zh:
DR地貌与DR off重复了可学习性测量,目标与样本共享一张图纸,每个图纸都有独立的图纸,只有一个新的斑点种子.
在独立绘图下,外观的平均值从物理、CUT和CycleGAN的0.542-0.548降至0.320-0.327,SonoSPADE的0.613降至0.508。
由于只有一个新的斑点种子,它停留在DR-off值的0.005以内,因此仅斑点种子并不能解释下降的原因.

blocks.en:
With the CT mask, the combined reward keeps 95 to 97% of its DR-off correlation under independent draws, so all four stages meet the pre-specified 80% retention rule.
Its pose sensitivity under randomization then rests on the segmentation term rather than on texture.
With each stage’s own seed-0 segmenter, it keeps 96% for SonoSPADE and 51 to 56% for the other three stages, so only SonoSPADE meets the rule.
Over segmenter seeds 0 to 2, it keeps 95 to 97% for SonoSPADE and 51 to 61% for the other three stages (post hoc; Supplementary Table S2.17).
In every seed, only SonoSPADE meets the rule.
The learned segmentation term shows the same split, falling from 0.453–0.482 to 0.173–0.233 for the other stages while SonoSPADE’s moves from 0.604 to 0.594.
These statements concern the reward landscape, and A.5 reports the policy side.
blocks.zh:
加上CT的面具,综合奖励在独立图纸下保持其DR-off关联的95%至97%,所以所有四个阶段都符合预先规定的80%保留规则.
它在随机化下具有敏感性,然后取决于分化术语而不是纹理。
每阶段都有96%的种子零分机,其他三个阶段则有51%至56%,因此只有SonoSPADE符合规定。
在分层种子0至2上,SonoSPADE保持95%至97%,其他三个阶段则保持51%至61%(特设后;补充表S2.17)。
每个种子中,只有索诺SPADE符合规则.
学习到的分化术语显示同样的分化,其他阶段从0.453-0.482降至0.173-0.233,而SonoSPADE则从0.604降至0.594。
这些声明涉及奖励情况,A.5报告政策方面。

blocks.en: A.5 Contact and DR in the closed loop
blocks.zh: A.5 闭环中的联系人和DR

blocks.en:
Table 4 reports, as measured, the contact-off minus contact-on delta at every level of the oracle ladder that Section 6 summarizes.
The 5 mm press cap and rigid tissue stay unchanged when contact is off.
blocks.zh:
表4报告了第6节概述的甲骨文阶梯各级接触点减三角洲的情况。
5毫米的压盖和刚性组织在接触中断时保持不变.

blocks.en:
Turning contact off raises the CT-mask servo-base error by 3.0 mm (6/6).
With learned masks it raises the final error by 0.8 to 2.0 mm and the servo-base error by 0.8 to 1.9 mm.
Of all servo deltas, only the final one under learned masks with physics frames, + 0.82 +0.82 mm (4/6), does not meet the decision rule.
In the post hoc per-axis split of Table 5 , contact lowers the mean axial error and both tilts of every level, including the scripted sweep, which reads no image.
blocks.zh:
关闭联系人将CT-mask服务器基错误提升3.0毫米(6/6).
有了有学识的口罩,最终误差增加了0.8至2.0毫米,伺服器基误差增加了0.8至1.9毫米.
在所有的servo deltas中,只有带有物理框架的学习口罩下的最后一张+0.82+0.82毫米(4/6)不符合决定规则.
在表5的后置每轴分割中,联系人会降低平均轴误差和每个关卡的倾斜,包括脚本扫描,不读图像.

blocks.en: Table 5 : Per-axis final error with contact on and off, 12 steps, the 60 held-out episodes (post hoc). Errors are patient-level means of the absolute SE(3)-log component in the target probe frame: lateral, elevational and axial translation, and out-of-plane tilt, in-plane tilt and roll. Base and policy rows pool seeds 0 to 2; four-stage rows also pool the four texture stages. In contact is the share of steps in contact. Gap is the mean height of the lowest face point above the plane, negative when pressed in. Lag is the mean distance between commanded and actual probe position after a step. The episodes are those of Table 4 . † Privileged.

blocks.en:
The DR ablation is pre-specified as descriptive.
With DR at evaluation, in training or in both, the final error changes by + 0.04 +0.04 to + 0.15 +0.15 mm against the SonoSPADE CT-mask configuration without DR.
Every CI includes 0, so we make no claim that DR helps the policy.
blocks.zh:
DR衰减预作描述说明.
随着DR在评价,训练中或两者兼而有之,最终误差变化为+0.04+0.04到+0.15+0.15毫米,对手为SonoSPADE CT-mask配置而无DR.
每个CI都包括0,所以我们没有声称DR帮助保单.

blocks.en: A.6 Distance to real frames and organ identity
blocks.zh: A.6 与真实框架和器官身份的距离

blocks.en:
Table 6 gives each stage’s distance to the 60 annotated Vitale frames (Section 8.6 ).
Both LOTUS versions output a linear intensity map, whereas the physics renderer is log-compressed (Supplementary Table S1.3).
By FID, both LOTUS versions are lower than physics (193.5 and 193.8 against 198.7), and by KID the original code and physics differ by less than one SD.
By C2ST AUC, physics is lower by point estimate ( 0.936 ± 0.102 0.936\pm 0.102 against 0.982 ± 0.037 0.982\pm 0.037 and 1.000 ± 0.000 1.000\pm 0.000 ), by less than its SD.
blocks.zh:
表6列出了每个阶段与60个附加说明的维塔勒框架的距离(第8.6节)。
LOTUS两个版本都输出一个线性强度图,而物理渲染器是log压缩的(补充表S1.3).
通过FID,LOTUS两个版本都低于物理(193.5和193.8对198.7),通过KID,原始代码和物理差异小于一个SD.
由C2ST AUC计算,物理按点估计值(0.936±0.102 0.936\pm 0.102相对0.982±0.037 0.982\pm 0.037和1.000±0.000\pm 0.000)较低,低于其SD.

blocks.en: Table 6 : Distance to real B-mode frames in matched sector geometry. Simulated side: 50 views per held-out patient (6 patients, 300 views) jittered around screened acoustic windows, warped to the real sector. Real side: the 60 annotated Vitale frames [ 15 ] , which no texture stage trained on. All scores use in-sector pixels only (sector mask eroded by 3 px). W1: intensity Wasserstein-1 distance. KID and FID: kernel and Fréchet Inception distances. C2ST AUC: area under the ROC curve of a CNN classifier two-sample test, mean ± \pm std over 5 repeats × \times 5 grouped folds (0.5 means the classifier cannot separate the domains). KID: mean ± \pm std over 100 random subsets of 50 frames per domain. Lower W1, KID and FID mean a smaller distance to the real frames. FID from 60 real frames is biased upward and is printed for completeness; KID is the unbiased kernel distance. NumPy renderer: the five-tissue appearance model of the authors’ earlier simulator (Supplementary Table S1.3). A post hoc label-permutation null with 200 permutations per stage gives a mean AUC of 0.50 (SD 0.07) for every stage and never reaches the observed AUC of any stage ( p = 1 / 201 p=1/201 each). Physics W1 is below the authors’ reimplementation of LOTUS in 6/6 held-out patients and is below it pooled. In a post hoc comparison with the original LOTUS code, physics W1 is lower in 5/6 patients and lower pooled. Supplementary Table S2.16 gives the null per stage and post hoc frame-bootstrap intervals for W1 and KID. The established-simulator rows run the same protocol with the renderer swapped (exploratory). The original LOTUS code runs with its published default parameters.
blocks.zh: 表6:相匹配扇区几何中与真实的B模式帧的距离。 模拟侧面:每个被搁置病人(6名病人,300名观察者)50次观看时,在被筛选的音响窗口周围颤抖,扭曲到真实区段. 真实侧面:60个注解Vitale帧 [15],没有经过纹理阶段训练. 所有分数只使用扇区像素(扇区面具被3px侵蚀). W1:强度瓦瑟斯坦-1距离. KID和FID:内核和Fréchet接力距离. C2ST AUC:CNN分类器二样测试的ROC曲线下的区域,指 ±\pm std 超过 5 重复 ×\time 5 分组折叠(0.5表示分类器不能将域分开). KID:指±\pm std 超过 100个随机子集,每个域50帧. 下W1,KID和FID意味着与真实帧的距离较小. 来自60个真帧的FID偏向向上,并按完整性打印;KID是无偏差的内核距离. NumPy渲染器:作者早期模拟器的五题外观模型(补充表S1.3). 一个带有200个每个阶段的附加标记-印记无效,每个阶段的平均AUC值为0.50(SD 0.07),从未达到任何阶段的观测到的AUC值(p=1/201p=1/201)。 物理W1低于作者在6/6被扣留病人中重新实施LOTUS,低于集合. 在与原LOTUS代码的后期比较中,物理W1在5/6患者中较低,集合率较低. 补充表S2.16给出了W1和KID的每个阶段的无效值和临时框-框间隔。 既定的模拟行与渲染器互换(探索)运行相同的协议. 最初的LOTUS代码与其公布的默认参数运行.

blocks.en:
Organ-identity consistency counts the organs, among liver, gallbladder, vessel and kidney, whose most frequent predicted class is correct both in simulation and on real frames.
With all 60 Vitale frames on the real side, the mean count per seed is 3.3 for SonoSPADE and physics, 3.0 for CUT and 2.3 for CycleGAN (Table 7 ).
The pre-specified rule for a difference needs both CUT and CycleGAN to trail both other stages by at least 0.67 organ.
CUT trails them by 0.3 organ.
With the 18 holdout frames instead, the counts are 1.7, 2.3, 2.0 and 1.7 in the same order.
Under this rule, neither real side shows a difference in organ identity across stages (Section 8.6 ).
We therefore make no claim that a global translator degrades organ identity.
The standard deviation over seeds reaches 1.2 organs, and spleen is consistent for no stage on any seed.
In an exploratory analysis on AUL liver frames [ 78 ] , liver is consistent on 3/3 seeds for physics, CUT and CycleGAN and on 1/3 for SonoSPADE.
blocks.zh:
器官识别一致性在肝脏、胆囊、血管和肾脏中都算在内,其最常预测的类别在模拟和真实框架上都是正确的。
所有60个Vitale帧都位于真实的一面,每个种子的平均计数分别为:SonoSPADE和物理3.3,CUT3.0和CycleGAN2.3(表7).
预先规定的区别规则需要CUT和CycleGAN两个阶段至少以0.67个器官跟踪其他两个阶段.
CUT以0.3的器官跟踪他们.
以18个搁置框代替,计数顺序为1.7,2.3,2.0和1.7.
根据这项规则,两个真正的方面都表明不同阶段的器官特性不同(第8.6节)。
因此,我们没有声称全球翻译会降低器官的特性。
对种子的标准偏差达到1.2个器官,对于任何种子上的任何阶段,脾脏都是一致的.
在对AUL肝框的探索性分析[78]中,肝脏在物理,CUT和CycleGAN的3/3种子和SonoSPADE的1/3种子上一致.

blocks.en: Table 7 : Cross-domain organ identity of each stage’s texture-matched segmenter. A cell counts the segmenter seeds, of 3, on which the modal predicted class of the organ is the correct class both in simulation (288 frames from the held-out patients) and on real frames. Liver, gallbladder (GB), vessel and spleen are scored on Vitale [ 15 ] : all 60 annotated frames, each predicted by a model that never trained on it (top), or only the 18 holdout frames that no segmenter trained on (bottom). Kidney is scored on the KidneyUS holdout [ 73 ] (107 frames) in both panels. Last column: organs of the four (liver, GB, vessel, kidney) per seed, mean ± \pm population std over the 3 seeds. Spleen is not a target and is descriptive only. The table is descriptive. Under the pre-specified rule, both panels detect no difference in organ-identity consistency across stages (not powered for equivalence).

blocks.en: Appendix B Outcomes of the pre-specified comparisons and exploratory experiments
blocks.zh: 附录B 预先规定的比较和探索实验的结果

blocks.en:
This appendix reports the outcome of each pre-specified comparison of Tables 5 and 1 , slot by slot, and of the exploratory experiments: the learned-mask controller experiment ( B.3 ), the canonical phantoms ( B.5 ), the contact surface ( B.8 ), the external cohort ( B.9 ) and the combination ( B.10 ).
Each decision below is printed in its pre-specified wording; Tables 5 and 1 and Fig. 1 give the same results at a glance.
In that wording, frames rendered from the CT label slice are the label-conditioned frames of Box 1 , and frames not rendered from it are the others.
Each decision of the comparison of published methods follows a rule fixed for its family before the held-out data were seen, and each is exploratory.
Each block names its family and size m m , and Holm’s adjustment runs within that family only.
Holm therefore controls the familywise error within each family, not across the exploratory families of Supplementary Table S4.1, so a few false differences are expected among all decisions.
Family boundaries matter at n = 6 n=6 : over the 25 contrasts of the oracle ladder as one family, 4 reach Holm’s threshold on the paired t t -test (Supplementary Table S2.5).
In Table 5 , the second mask-source family is MASK-P, the pretrained-backbone family IMN-T and the LPIPS reward family LPIPS-R; in Table 1 , the CT-anatomy difference and equivalence families are CTA-D and CTA-E.
The exploratory experiments fixed their decision rules before any of their outputs existed.
Their families are LM-D and LM-E for the learned-mask controller experiment, SKIN-D and SKIN-E for the contact surface, AMOS-P and AMOS-S for the external cohort, and CMB-D, CMB-E and CMB-G for the combination.
Secondary comparisons give a t t interval and no decision.
Fig. 1 draws the difference of every plugged method of the five slot families of Tables 5 and 1 from its slot’s reference, with its 95% and 90% t t intervals.
blocks.zh:
本附录汇报了对表5和表1,按档次划分的每个预指定比较结果,以及探索性实验的结果:学习-面具控制器实验(B.3),舟子幽灵实验(B.5),接触面(B.8),外部组群(B.9)和组合(B.10).
以下每项决定均按其事先规定的措辞印发; 表5和1及图1则对结果作了一目了然。
在该措辞中,从CT标签切片中制成的帧是Box 1的标签条件框架,没有制成的帧是其他的.
每项对公布的方法进行比较的决定都遵循了在发现搁置数据之前为其家庭确定的规则,而且每项决定都是探索性的。
Holm的调整只在家中进行。
因此,Holm控制着每个家庭内部的家庭错误,而不是补充表S4.1的探索性家庭的错误,因此,在所有决定中,预计会出现一些错误的差异。
家族边界在n=6n=6时很重要:在甲骨文阶梯作为一家的25个对比度上,4个在配对的 t - t -测试中达到霍尔姆的阈值(补充表S2.5).
在表5中,第二个口罩来源家庭是MASK-P,预训背骨家族IMN-T和LPIPS奖励家族LPIPS-R;在表1中,CT-解剖差异和等效家庭是CTA-D和CTA-E.
探索性试验在其任何产出存在之前就确定了其决定规则。
他们的家族是LM-D和LM-E,用于学习面具控制器实验,SKIN-D和SKIN-E用于接触面,AMOS-P和AMOS-S用于外部组群,CMB-D,CMB-E和CMB-G用于组合.
二次比较给出t t间隔,没有决定.

All four published texture stages [ 36 , 37 , 38 , 39 ] end farther from the target than SonoSPADE [ 4 ] , at 16.13 to 17.64 mm against 13.13 mm (Holm p p 0.011 to 0.038).
Unlike SonoSPADE, which we used unchanged, they read no CT label, run at the smaller network sizes of the reference stages and train on 1,540 frames for 800 iterations, against SonoSPADE’s 4,620 for 1,500. A difference thus mixes texture with label access and budget and does not rank textures.
FastCUT, DCLGAN and UNSB are our reimplementations, with the official loss weights.

These caveats apply to SAMUS and the pretrained backbones of this slot. • SAMUS runs at inference only. • SAMUS was trained and evaluated with one positive point per object. • Its box prompts pass through the prompt encoder and mask decoder of SAM ViT-B, which SAMUS kept frozen. • The non-privileged row depends on the U-Net for its boxes, so it is not independent of the reference. • SAMUS runs with its own preprocessing and with no adaptation to the testbed’s frames. • SAMUS’s real-frame Dice is not reported, because its training corpus may include the real test frames. • The pretrained networks start their backbones from torchvision ImageNet-1K weights. • Every other setting is that of their from-scratch twins. • Their pretraining used natural RGB photographs, whereas their input is a gray frame replicated to three channels. • The contact rows of SAMUS and of the pretrained networks run a policy trained with U-Net masks under their masks, out of its training distribution.

blocks.en:
Family controller, m = 10 m=10 , against the REINFORCE residual under CT masks on SonoSPADE frames.
Behavior cloning and DAgger policies use BatchNorm in eval mode, the pre-specified primary setting.
A full-twist controller outputs the whole twist without the servo base, whereas a residual controller adds to it a correction bounded at half of a max a_{\max} . PPO, residual [ 54 , 59 ] PPO, residual, and the REINFORCE residual show no detectable difference in the controller slot ( − 0.19 -0.19 mm [ − 0.53 , + 0.16 ] [-0.53,+0.16] ; not powered for equivalence; exploratory). The TD3 residual collapsed to a constant action within about 500 environment steps of its first update (post hoc diagnostic).
From then on, it adds the same offset at the residual bound on every axis, whatever the image.
Under CT masks, its physics and SonoSPADE trajectories therefore coincide in seeds 0 and 1.
Seed 2 differs only because it settled on a different constant action. blocks.en:
Families LM-D and LM-E, m = 6 m=6 each, contrast the DAgger and BC residuals of this experiment with the learned-mask servo base and with each other, on physics and SonoSPADE frames.
LM-D tests a difference with the paired t t -test, and LM-E tests equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm with two one-sided tests.
Each contrast states the decision of both families, and Table 2 gives its statistics. B1, DAgger residual minus learned-mask servo base, physics frames Under learned masks with the physics stage, the DAgger residual gives a lower final translation error than the learned-mask servo base ( − 3.17 -3.17 mm [ − 5.04 -5.04 , − 1.31 -1.31 ], 6/6; exploratory). B2, DAgger residual minus learned-mask servo base, SonoSPADE frames Under learned masks with the SonoSPADE stage, the DAgger residual and the learned-mask servo base show no detectable difference ( − 1.09 -1.09 mm [ − 2.70 -2.70 , + 0.51 +0.51 ]; exploratory).
Their equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown either (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). B3, BC residual minus learned-mask servo base, physics frames Under learned masks with the physics stage, the BC residual and the learned-mask servo base show no detectable difference ( − 2.91 -2.91 mm [ − 5.52 -5.52 , − 0.30 -0.30 ]; exploratory).
Their equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown either (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). B4, BC residual minus learned-mask servo base, SonoSPADE frames Under learned masks with the SonoSPADE stage, the BC residual and the learned-mask servo base show no detectable difference ( − 0.80 -0.80 mm [ − 2.36 -2.36 , + 0.76 +0.76 ]; exploratory).
Their equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown either (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). P1, DAgger residual minus BC residual, physics frames Under learned masks with the physics stage, the DAgger and BC residuals show no detectable difference ( − 0.27 -0.27 mm [ − 2.47 -2.47 , + 1.94 +1.94 ]; exploratory).
Their equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown either (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). P2, DAgger residual minus BC residual, SonoSPADE frames Under learned masks with the SonoSPADE stage, the DAgger and BC residuals show no detectable difference ( − 0.29 -0.29 mm [ − 2.02 -2.02 , + 1.45 +1.45 ]; exploratory).
Their equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown either (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). With physics frames and learned masks, the testbed separates 1 of the three method pairs of this arm at n = 6 n=6 (exploratory).
With SonoSPADE frames and learned masks, no pair of methods in this arm is separated at n = 6 n=6 (exploratory).
Table 2 names each separated pair and the direction of its difference. Conditions of every result. • At run time, the learners in this arm read only the frame history and the target frame. • The servo base under them reads only the learned masks of the same frames. • Both learners were trained on labels from a privileged pose-oracle teacher on training patients. • The servo base and the segmenters were fit with true poses and CT labels of training patients. • Every episode keeps the contact plane through the target window face, normal to the target beam. • Starts below that plane are lifted onto it. • After the lift, no start lies deeper than the target face. • With the SonoSPADE stage, every frame is rendered from the CT label slice. • The two learners were chosen as the lowest CT-mask rows on the same six held-out patients, with BatchNorm in eval mode. • New learner seeds remove the seed part of that selection, not the patient part. • Other readings of “lowest” pick other pairs: the three lowest errors span 0.65 mm, below the slot’s MDD of 1.74 mm over the contrasts complete when the learners were chosen. The DAgger residual keeps its sign in 2 of 3 seeds. • These learners ran earlier under learned masks with other learner seeds on the same artifacts, so this arm is not independent of those runs. Supplementary Table S6.1 gives the other comparisons of this experiment (secondary; no decision).

blocks.en: At run time, the learners in this arm read only the frame history and the target frame.
blocks.zh: 在运行时间,这个臂的学习者只读帧历史和目标帧.

blocks.en: The servo base under them reads only the learned masks of the same frames.
blocks.zh: 它们下面的伺服器基地只读到同一帧的学习过的口罩.

blocks.en: Both learners were trained on labels from a privileged pose-oracle teacher on training patients.
blocks.zh: 两名学员都接受了来自一位特殊姿势教师的标签培训,以培训病人。

blocks.en: The servo base and the segmenters were fit with true poses and CT labels of training patients.
blocks.zh: 伺服器基座和支架都配有真正的姿势和训练病人的CT标签.

blocks.en: Every episode keeps the contact plane through the target window face, normal to the target beam.
blocks.zh: 每集保持接触飞机通过目标窗口面,对目标梁正常.

blocks.en: Starts below that plane are lifted onto it.
blocks.zh: 从飞机下方开始就升起

blocks.en: After the lift, no start lies deeper than the target face.
blocks.zh: 升降机后,没有任何开始比目标面更深.

blocks.en: With the SonoSPADE stage, every frame is rendered from the CT label slice.
blocks.zh: 有了索诺SPADE阶段,每个帧都从CT标签切片中渲染出来.

blocks.en: The two learners were chosen as the lowest CT-mask rows on the same six held-out patients, with BatchNorm in eval mode.
blocks.zh: 两个学习者被选为同一六名被搁置病人中最低的CT-mask列,BatchNorm处于eval模式.

blocks.en: New learner seeds remove the seed part of that selection, not the patient part.
blocks.zh: 新的学习者种子去除选择的种子部分,而不是病人部分.

blocks.en: Other readings of “lowest” pick other pairs: the three lowest errors span 0.65 mm, below the slot’s MDD of 1.74 mm over the contrasts complete when the learners were chosen. The DAgger residual keeps its sign in 2 of 3 seeds.
blocks.zh: 其他“最低”读数选用其他对数:三个最低误差为0.65毫米,低于该插槽的1.74毫米的MDD,在选择学习者时则完成对比。 Dagger残留在3个种子中的2个保持其标志.

blocks.en: These learners ran earlier under learned masks with other learner seeds on the same artifacts, so this arm is not independent of those runs.
blocks.zh: 这些学习者在较早时候在学习的面具下跑步,与其他学习者的种子在同一件文物上,因此这个手臂并不独立于这些跑步.

blocks.en:
Family reward, m = 2 m=2 , against the match score S S , retrained in the same way as the plugged rewards.
Two privileged rewards follow prior work: the change in pose distance used by SonoGym [ 29 ] , and pose distance plus visible organ area, adapted from VesNet-RL [ 28 ] . SSIM appearance term [ 63 ] The SSIM appearance term gives a lower final translation error than the paper’s S S in the reward potential slot ( − 0.047 -0.047 mm [ − 0.085 , − 0.009 ] [-0.085,-0.009] , 5/6; exploratory).
Per seed, SSIM minus S S is − 0.028 -0.028 , + 0.004 +0.004 and − 0.116 -0.116 mm, so 2 of 3 seeds share its sign (post hoc; B.11 ). NMI appearance term [ 64 ] The NMI appearance term and the paper’s S S show no detectable difference in the reward potential slot ( + 0.006 +0.006 mm [ − 0.042 , + 0.053 ] [-0.042,+0.053] ; not powered for equivalence; exploratory). Pose distance plus organ area, privileged, secondary [ 28 ] Pose distance plus organ area ends at 11.90 mm, − 0.070 -0.070 mm [ − 0.158 , + 0.018 ] [-0.158,+0.018] , 5/6 from S S (privileged, secondary). Family LPIPS-R, m = 1 m=1 , against the same S S . LPIPS appearance term [ 65 ] The LPIPS appearance term gives a lower final translation error than the paper’s S S in the reward slot ( − 0.066 -0.066 mm [ − 0.122 , − 0.011 ] [-0.122,-0.011] , 5/6; exploratory).
Had LPIPS, fixed later in a family of its own, joined the reward family ( m = 3 m=3 ), SSIM’s paired t t p p of 0.0246 would lie above Holm’s first threshold (post hoc). No reward would then be lower, and the combination rule would have changed no slot. These caveats apply to the LPIPS reward. • LPIPS enters as the appearance term of S = 0.6 ​ S seg + 0.4 ​ ( 1 − LPIPS ) S=0.6\,S_{\mathrm{seg}}+0.4\,(1-\mathrm{LPIPS}) . • Its AlexNet trunk was trained on natural RGB photographs. • Its heads were calibrated on human judgments of distorted natural-image patches, not on ultrasound. • LPIPS trains under the shared-seed rendering of the paper’s S S , so a deep-feature term may match the shared speckle field rather than anatomy. • Its independent-speckle condition is not reported. • The SB3 positive control certifies the SB3 rows, not REINFORCE.

The original LOTUS code [ 12 , 7 ] and our reimplementation of it end at 11.84 and 11.86 mm, neither differing detectably from the reference physics renderer, with which the privileged CT-mask policy trained on physics frames ends at 11.81 mm.
The original code runs unchanged, with its published default parameters.
SIMUS [ 10 , 11 ] , a secondary comparison run through PyMUST, uses 2 scatterers per mm 2 , too few for fully developed speckle (settings in Supplementary S1).
All three are shown equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (post hoc TOST).
The policy’s servo base reads only CT label slices, so a renderer acts only through the bounded residual.
In the reward and renderer slots, this equivalence describes the learner and servo configuration and does not make the plugged methods interchangeable.
Family renderer, m = 2 m=2 , against the physics renderer under the physics-trained CT-mask policy. LOTUS, original code [ 12 ] The original LOTUS code and the physics renderer show no detectable difference in the renderer slot ( + 0.03 +0.03 mm [ − 0.03 , + 0.09 ] [-0.03,+0.09] ; not powered for equivalence; exploratory). LOTUS, authors’ reimplementation [ 12 ] The authors’ reimplementation of LOTUS and the physics renderer show no detectable difference in the renderer slot ( + 0.05 +0.05 mm [ − 0.05 , + 0.15 ] [-0.05,+0.15] ; not powered for equivalence; exploratory). SIMUS via PyMUST, secondary [ 10 , 11 ] Under SIMUS, the policy ends at 12.40 mm, + 0.49 +0.49 mm [ + 0.21 , + 0.78 ] [+0.21,+0.78] from physics (secondary).

On canonical digital phantoms, the physics renderer meets 5 of its 8 bands fixed before rendering, the original LOTUS code 2 of its 4 and SIMUS 5 of its 8 (descriptive; Supplementary S1).
Of these bands, 2, 2 and 1 could not be scored, because a wire was not measurable in every seed.
The phantoms test renderer properties against bands fixed in advance.
Several bands are design checks that hold by the renderer’s construction.
No renderer is called realistic.
Scored on native 512 by 160 frames, the output speckle SNR is 3.57, 4.71 and 1.55 for physics, the original LOTUS code and SIMUS, against 1.91 for a Rayleigh envelope.
No physics wire is measurable in every one of the 10 seeds. Most wire peaks stand less than 6 dB above the speckle background, and those at 50 and 70 mm also reach the per-frame white level.
SIMUS and the original LOTUS code cast no shadow below the bone slab (Supplementary Table S1.5).

在这些乐队中,有2,2和1无法得分,因为每根种子都无法测量一根线.
幽灵测试渲染器在预先固定波段上的特性.
多个波段是设计检查,由渲染器的构造进行。
任何渲染器都不叫现实。
在原生的512上以160帧计分,输出Speekle SNR为3.57,4.71和1.55,物理,原始LOTUS代码和SIMUS,而Rayleigh信封为1.91.
10个种子中没有一个物理线可以测量。 大多数铁丝峰在光谱背景上方低于6dB,50和70毫米的铁丝峰也达到了每帧白色的水平.
SIMUS和最初的LOTUS代码在骨板下没有投影(补充表S1.5).

blocks.en: B.6 CT anatomy
blocks.zh: B.6 CT解剖学

blocks.en:
Relabeling the CTs with TotalSegmentator v2 moves the five reference levels of the oracle ladder by − 0.62 -0.62 to + 0.08 +0.08 mm, none detectably; with the reference TotalSegmentator dataset masks [ 3 ] , they end at 11.65 to 17.20 mm.
The three privileged CT-mask levels are equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm.
For the two learned-mask levels, equivalence is not shown.
All 19 CTs are in TotalSegmentator’s own training data, so these labels are in-sample predictions: the rows are a label-noise sensitivity check, not a test of an independent CT segmenter.
Families CTA-D and CTA-E, m = 5 m=5 each, contrast TotalSegmentator v2 labels [ 3 ] with the reference labels at the same oracle-ladder level, seeds 0 to 2.
CTA-D tests a difference with the paired t t -test, and CTA-E tests equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm with two one-sided tests.
Each level states the decision of both families. R1, CT-mask servo base, physics, privileged With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels, rung R1 is equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm ( + 0.08 +0.08 mm, 90% CI [ − 0.20 , + 0.35 ] [-0.20,+0.35] ; TOST, Holm p p = 0.003; exploratory). R2, learned-mask servo base, physics With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels, rung R2 shows no detectable change ( − 0.62 -0.62 mm [ − 1.67 , + 0.43 ] [-1.67,+0.43] ; equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm not shown, TOST Holm p p = 0.196; exploratory). R3, learned-mask servo base, per-tissue stage With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels, rung R3 shows no detectable change ( − 0.51 -0.51 mm [ − 1.29 , + 0.26 ] [-1.29,+0.26] ; equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm not shown, TOST Holm p p = 0.166; exploratory). R4, CT-mask policy, physics, final weights, privileged With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels, rung R4 is equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm ( − 0.11 -0.11 mm, 90% CI [ − 0.66 , + 0.44 ] [-0.66,+0.44] ; TOST, Holm p p = 0.045; exploratory). R5, CT-mask policy, per-tissue stage, final weights, privileged With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels, rung R5 is equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm ( − 0.07 -0.07 mm, 90% CI [ − 0.66 , + 0.52 ] [-0.66,+0.52] ; TOST, Holm p p = 0.045; exploratory). These caveats apply to the CT-anatomy slot. • TotalSegmentator v2 rebuilds each label volume from its own predictions on the same raw CT, in fast mode at 3.0 mm. • The CT intensities, the windows, the episode setups and every trained artifact stay those of the primary results. • Each row therefore measures what the frozen pipeline does when its anatomy comes from an automatic segmenter. • R1, R2 and R4 render physics frames; R3 and R5, SonoSPADE frames. • No CT-anatomy row runs on the replication cohort, whose 20 CTs lie in the same training split. • Fast mode is coarser than the 1.5 mm default, which is not reported. • The class mapping and the exclusions are those of the reference labels. • The trained artifacts never saw the new labels, so a change mixes label noise with the shift between training and evaluation labels. • The reference of each level is its rerun on the reference labels, so the values of Table 4 stay primary. The reference masks were drafted by public and intermediate nnU-Net models and then reviewed and corrected by hand [ 3 ] .
TotalSegmentator v2 was trained on images that include these subjects (TotalSegmentator v2 release notes).
Agreement between the masks and TotalSegmentator predictions is therefore not an accuracy estimate.
The conclusion is ours, not the paper’s.
The TotalSegmentator v2 fast weights used here are named for 1559 training subjects, up from 1139 for v1.
No source names the added subjects.
All 39 CTs of the testbed therefore stay treated as training data of the label model.
The CT-anatomy rows stay a sensitivity check.

blocks.en: B.7 Plugged methods on the replication cohort

blocks.en:
The cohort rerun evaluates the frozen plugged artifacts on the 20 replication CTs and attaches no decision.
Supplementary Table S6.7 gives each method’s mean error on the six held-out patients and on the 20 CTs.
SAM, MedSAM, the look-ahead, the physics policy under each renderer, SIMUS, SAMUS, the pretrained backbones, LPIPS and the CT-anatomy labels have no cohort run.
The minimum detectable differences below use the all-pairs rule fixed for the ordering check; Tables 5 and 1 give those of the contrasts with each slot’s reference (texture 3.24 mm), which the decisions use.
As pre-specified, the minimum detectable difference of each slot is computed at n = 6 n=6 , 20 and 26. Controller, plug cohort Across 20 new CTs, the controller methods keep 63 of 66 pairwise orderings of the original six (Kendall tau-b 0.91 [0.76, 0.94]; exploratory); differences smaller than 3.51 mm are not detectable at n = 6 n=6 .
At n = 20 n=20 and 26, the minimum detectable differences are 1.40 and 1.24 mm. Mask source, plug cohort Across 20 new CTs, the mask source methods keep 16 of 21 pairwise orderings of the original six (Kendall tau-b 0.52 [0.24, 0.62]; exploratory). Differences smaller than 2.54 mm are not detectable at n = 6 n=6 .
At n = 20 n=20 and 26, the minimum detectable differences are 0.89 and 0.81 mm. Texture stage, plug cohort Across 20 new CTs, the texture methods keep 17 of 28 pairwise orderings of the original six (Kendall tau-b 0.21 [0.00, 0.64]; exploratory); differences smaller than 2.13 mm are not detectable at n = 6 n=6 .
At n = 20 n=20 and 26, the minimum detectable differences are 1.01 and 0.90 mm. Reward, plug cohort Across 20 new CTs, the reward methods keep 25 of 28 pairwise orderings of the original six (Kendall tau-b 0.79 [ − 0.21 -0.21 , 0.93]; exploratory); differences smaller than 0.131 mm are not detectable at n = 6 n=6 .
At n = 20 n=20 and 26, the minimum detectable differences are 0.058 and 0.055 mm. Renderer, plug cohort Across 20 new CTs, the renderer methods keep 3 of 3 pairwise orderings of the original six (Kendall tau-b 1.00 [0.33, 1.00]; exploratory); differences smaller than 0.24 mm are not detectable at n = 6 n=6 .
At n = 20 n=20 and 26, the minimum detectable differences are 0.15 and 0.13 mm. In the renderer slot, each policy is trained and evaluated under its renderer, as pre-specified, not the physics-trained policy of Table 1 .

blocks.en: B.8 Contact surface
blocks.zh: B.8 接触面

blocks.en:
Families SKIN-D and SKIN-E, m = 5 m=5 each, contrast the skin-tangent contact plane with the target-anchored plane at the same level and seed.
SKIN-D tests a change with the paired t t -test, and SKIN-E tests equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm with two one-sided tests.
Each level states the decision of both families, and Table 3 gives their statistics with the plane quantities of each level. Static start With a contact plane tangent to the skin at the start pose, the static start shows no detectable change ( + 0.36 +0.36 mm [ − 0.55 -0.55 , + 1.28 +1.28 ]; exploratory).
Its equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown (TOST, Holm p = 0.337 p=0.337 ). Scripted sweep With a contact plane tangent to the skin at the start pose, the scripted sweep shows no detectable change ( + 0.55 +0.55 mm [ − 0.70 -0.70 , + 1.80 +1.80 ]; exploratory).
Its equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown (TOST, Holm p = 0.792 p=0.792 ). Pose oracle, privileged With a contact plane tangent to the skin at the start pose, the pose oracle shows no detectable change ( + 0.96 +0.96 mm [ − 0.20 -0.20 , + 2.12 +2.12 ]; exploratory).
Its equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). CT-mask servo base, physics frames, seeds 0 to 2 With a contact plane tangent to the skin at the start pose, the CT-mask servo base shows no detectable change ( + 3.53 +3.53 mm [ + 0.89 +0.89 , + 6.18 +6.18 ]; exploratory).
Its equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). Learned-mask servo base, SonoSPADE frames, seeds 0 to 2 With a contact plane tangent to the skin at the start pose, the learned-mask SonoSPADE base shows no detectable change ( + 3.00 +3.00 mm [ + 0.29 +0.29 , + 5.72 +5.72 ]; exploratory).
Its equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm is not shown (TOST, Holm p = 1.000 p=1.000 ). Conditions of every result. • The skin-tangent plane is fixed by the patient’s skin where the start pose’s beam axis enters it. • The start is still drawn around the target pose, so this plane lies near the target window. • Both servo bases keep the calibrations of the primary results, fit with the target-anchored plane. • No artifact was retrained for the new contact surface. • The angle between the two planes and the offset of the target face are printed with each rung. Supplementary Table S6.2 gives the other comparisons of this experiment, with its tangent and tilted windows (secondary; descriptive).

blocks.en: B.9 External cohort
blocks.zh: B.9 外部组别

blocks.en:
Families AMOS-P, m = 3 m=3 , and AMOS-S, m = 2 m=2 , repeat the contrasts of the replication cohort on 30 CTs of the public AMOS 2022 dataset [ 71 ] .
Each family uses the two-sided sign-flip test with 1,000,000 Monte Carlo sign vectors and seed 0, with Holm within the family, and the CT is the unit.
C1 and C2 replicate when they hold with the sign of the original six, and C3 tests equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm in every policy arm. Conditions of every result. • These 30 CTs come from AMOS 2022, a public dataset other than TotalSegmentator; their labels are TotalSegmentator v2 predictions checked against the AMOS manual organ labels, and every trained artifact is unchanged. • This is external replication in simulation only: CT source and label source change together, and no AMOS result speaks to real ultrasound. • Of 79 eligible AMOS CTs (slice spacing at most 2.5 mm), 77 passed the label check and 76 the window screen; the first 30 in the seeded order form the cohort (Table 4 ). • Whether TotalSegmentator v2 was trained on AMOS images is not recorded, so the labels are treated as in-sample predictions; no artifact of the testbed was trained on an AMOS CT. C1, learned minus CT masks, physics stage On 30 AMOS CTs, learned masks with the physics stage add 4.01 mm over CT masks ([ + 3.40 +3.40 , + 4.62 +4.62 ], 29/30, Holm p = 3.0 × 10 − 6 p=3.0\times 10^{-6} ; exploratory), replicating the CT-to-learned-mask gap on CTs from outside the TotalSegmentator dataset. C2, per-tissue stage minus physics, learned-mask servo base On 30 AMOS CTs, the per-tissue stage gives a lower learned-mask base error than physics ( − 2.73 -2.73 mm [ − 3.43 -3.43 , − 2.03 -2.03 ], 27/30, Holm p = 3.0 × 10 − 6 p=3.0\times 10^{-6} ; exploratory). C3, REINFORCE final minus after imitation, 8 policy arms On 30 AMOS CTs, REINFORCE fine-tuning changes the final error by less than 1 mm in every policy arm (TOST, intersection-union, Holm p = 0.009 p=0.009 ; exploratory).
Averaged over the 8 policy arms, REINFORCE fine-tuning changes the final error by + 0.17 +0.17 mm [ + 0.07 +0.07 , + 0.27 +0.27 ] on 30 AMOS CTs (TOST at ± 1 \pm 1 mm, Monte Carlo sign-flip p = 1.0 × 10 − 6 p=1.0\times 10^{-6} , 1,000,000 sign vectors, seed 0; secondary). Gap, CT-mask servo base minus pose oracle On 30 AMOS CTs, the servo base under CT masks ends 10.68 mm farther from the target than the privileged pose oracle (oracle-to-CT-mask gap; exploratory) (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue). Bound, look-ahead minus CT-mask servo base On 30 AMOS CTs, privileged look-ahead ascent on the CT-mask match score (a privileged reference rung) ends below the CT-mask servo base by 4.51 mm [3.74, 5.29] (exploratory) (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
Both meet the decision rule, with the same sign in 30/30 CTs (Monte Carlo sign-flip p = 1.0 × 10 − 6 p=1.0\times 10^{-6} and Holm p = 2.0 × 10 − 6 p=2.0\times 10^{-6} each in family AMOS-S; Table 7 ).
This bound uses look-ahead sampling seed 0, as pre-specified; Section 8.5 gives it with sampling seeds 0 to 2 averaged (estimation only). Ordering of rungs and stages The rung and stage ordering of the original six recurs on 30 AMOS CTs (100% of the 40 rule-holding pairs keep their sign; Kendall τ b = 0.79 \tau_{b}=0.79 [0.70, 0.91]; exploratory). The comparison with the replication cohort is estimation only and attaches no p p and no decision. • C1: + 4.01 +4.01 mm [ + 3.40 +3.40 , + 4.62 +4.62 ] on 30 AMOS CTs, + 2.57 +2.57 mm [ + 1.66 +1.66 , + 3.47 +3.47 ] on the 20 replication-cohort CTs and + 4.92 +4.92 mm on the original six. AMOS minus replication cohort: + 1.44 +1.44 mm [ + 0.38 +0.38 , + 2.51 +2.51 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • C2: − 2.73 -2.73 mm [ − 3.43 -3.43 , − 2.03 -2.03 ] on 30 AMOS CTs, − 2.04 -2.04 mm [ − 2.75 -2.75 , − 1.33 -1.33 ] on the 20 replication-cohort CTs and − 4.06 -4.06 mm on the original six. AMOS minus replication cohort: − 0.68 -0.68 mm [ − 1.65 -1.65 , + 0.29 +0.29 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • gap: + 10.68 +10.68 mm [ + 9.99 +9.99 , + 11.37 +11.37 ] on 30 AMOS CTs, + 11.17 +11.17 mm [ + 10.32 +10.32 , + 12.03 +12.03 ] on the 20 replication-cohort CTs and + 10.12 +10.12 mm on the original six. AMOS minus replication cohort: − 0.49 -0.49 mm [ − 1.56 -1.56 , + 0.57 +0.57 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • bound: − 4.51 -4.51 mm [ − 5.29 -5.29 , − 3.74 -3.74 ] on 30 AMOS CTs, − 4.96 -4.96 mm [ − 6.23 -6.23 , − 3.68 -3.68 ] on the 20 replication-cohort CTs and − 3.52 -3.52 mm on the original six at look-ahead seed 0. AMOS minus replication cohort: + 0.44 +0.44 mm [ − 1.01 -1.01 , + 1.90 +1.90 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • Across the 8 policy arms, the REINFORCE change on AMOS minus that on the replication cohort ranges from − 0.05 -0.05 to + 0.40 +0.40 mm (Welch 95% CIs within [ − 0.27 -0.27 , + 0.83 +0.83 ]; estimation only). • Kendall τ b \tau_{b} between the replication cohort’s and AMOS’s 12 cell means is 0.82 [0.55, 0.91] (two-sample case bootstrap; descriptive). • Learned-mask base by stage, lowest first (descriptive, no p p ): on 30 AMOS CTs per-tissue 13.91 mm, physics 16.63 mm, CUT 16.77 mm, CycleGAN 16.93 mm; on the replication cohort per-tissue 13.71 mm, physics 15.75 mm, CycleGAN 16.14 mm, CUT 16.31 mm; on the original six per-tissue 13.13 mm, CUT 16.84 mm, CycleGAN 16.85 mm, physics 17.20 mm. • The two cohorts differ in CT source, label source and patients, and possibly in scanners and protocols, so a difference between them is not attributed to any one of these; an interval that covers 0 does not show that a gap is unchanged. • The AMOS cohort has 30 CTs and the replication cohort 20, so their intervals differ in width and their tests in power; a difference between their decisions is not read as a difference between the cohorts. Both cohorts rerun the same trained artifacts, so they replicate over CTs, not over training runs.
On both, C1 and C2 are smaller in magnitude than on the six held-out patients, whose intervals are wide. The look-ahead bound is larger in magnitude ( − 4.51 -4.51 and − 4.96 -4.96 against − 3.52 -3.52 mm at look-ahead seed 0).
A pre-specified relabeling control reruns the 20 replication CTs with TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels. • With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels on 20 replication-cohort CTs, C1 changes by + 0.84 +0.84 mm [ − 0.03 -0.03 , + 1.70 +1.70 ] (13/20, paired; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels on both, AMOS minus the relabeled replication cohort, C1: + 0.61 +0.61 mm [ − 0.71 -0.71 , + 1.92 +1.92 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels on 20 replication-cohort CTs, C2 changes by − 0.61 -0.61 mm [ − 1.43 -1.43 , + 0.20 +0.20 ] (11/20, paired; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels on both, AMOS minus the relabeled replication cohort, C2: − 0.07 -0.07 mm [ − 1.17 -1.17 , + 1.03 +1.03 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels on 20 replication-cohort CTs, gap changes by − 0.54 -0.54 mm [ − 1.21 -1.21 , + 0.12 +0.12 ] (15/20, paired; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels on both, AMOS minus the relabeled replication cohort, gap: + 0.05 +0.05 mm [ − 1.10 -1.10 , + 1.20 +1.20 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels in place of the reference labels on 20 replication-cohort CTs, bound changes by − 0.38 -0.38 mm [ − 1.39 -1.39 , + 0.63 +0.63 ] (11/20, paired; estimation only). • With TotalSegmentator labels on both, AMOS minus the relabeled replication cohort, bound: + 0.82 +0.82 mm [ − 0.69 -0.69 , + 2.34 +2.34 ] (Welch 95% CI; estimation only). • The relabeled replication cohort’s labels are in-sample predictions for TotalSegmentator, so this control holds the label model fixed, not its accuracy. Secondary and descriptive results follow.
Without the 9 AMOS CTs whose aorta median is at least 300 HU, C1 is + 4.20 +4.20 mm [ + 3.44 +3.44 , + 4.95 +4.95 ] and C2 is − 2.47 -2.47 mm [ − 3.26 -3.26 , − 1.67 -1.67 ] on 21 CTs (secondary; no decision).
Against the AMOS manual labels, TotalSegmentator’s Dice on the 30 cohort CTs has a median of 0.96 for the liver and 0.93 for the kidneys (all 12 shared structures in Table 5 ; descriptive).
The labels may be in-sample predictions for TotalSegmentator, so this agreement may be optimistic.
For context, Table 6 prints the five CT-anatomy rungs of the original six on TotalSegmentator labels beside the same rungs on AMOS; the two share the label model and differ in CT source, patients, n, the labels of the calibration fit and the window source (descriptive).
Supplementary Tables S6.3 to S6.5 give the ordering cells, the per-case descriptors and the secondary rows of the AMOS cohort, never pooled with the other sets.
blocks.zh:
