blocks.en: B.10 Combination and benchmark baseline
blocks.zh: B.10 合并和基准基准

blocks.en:
Families CMB-D and CMB-E, m = 4 m=4 each, and CMB-G, m = 2 m=2 , test the rule-chosen combination on the 20 replication CTs, with the exact sign-flip test and Holm within each family.
CMB-D tests a difference from the authors’ original pipeline and from the learned-mask servo base, CMB-E tests equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm, and CMB-G tests the gap to the pose oracle.
The six held-out patients and the 30 AMOS CTs give estimates only, and Table 9 gives every result.
The learned-mask controller arm ( B.3 ) ran on the six held-out patients only and had no result when the rule was written, so none of its rows is ranked against the benchmark baseline. Conditions of every result. • The combination was assembled by a rule fixed before its runs: in each slot the authors’ component stays unless the slot’s decision found a published method lower. • The rule was written when its outcome and that of the post hoc lowest-error table were already known. • The combination trains with learner seeds 6 to 8, and its renders keep the artifact seed. • Only the reward slot changed: the SSIM appearance term replaced the NCC term of the match score in the REINFORCE reward (Table 5 : − 0.047 -0.047 mm [ − 0.085 -0.085 , − 0.009 -0.009 ], 5/6, Holm p = 0.049 p=0.049 , under CT masks with SonoSPADE frames). • That difference lies below the slot’s post hoc minimum detectable difference (0.085 mm), kept its sign in 2 of 3 seeds, and was measured under privileged CT masks. • LPIPS also reads lower but was not a candidate, because its result was not available to the rule when the rule was fixed. • No component was chosen with the 20 replication-cohort CTs that test the combination; the six held-out patients informed the choice. • These 20 cases come from the same public dataset (16 of 20 from institute E); this is internal replication, not external validity. • At run time, the combination reads only the frame history and the target frame, and its servo base only the learned masks of those frames. • Its imitation start, the behavior-cloning anchor of its RL phase, its servo base and its segmenters were fit with true poses and CT labels of training patients, and every episode keeps the contact plane through the target window face. • With the SonoSPADE stage, every frame is rendered from the CT label slice, so label information reaches the image.
blocks.zh:
家庭CMB-D和CMB-E,m=4 m=4 m=4 m;家庭CMB-G,m=2 m=2 m=2 在20个复制型CT上测试规则选择组合,每个家族内部进行精确的标志-flip测试和Holm.
CMB-D测试与作者最初的管道和学习-面具服务器基础的区别,CMB-E测试在±1\pm 1毫米范围内的等效性,CMB-G测试与姿势甲骨文的差距.
六个被搁置的病人和30个AMOS CT只给出估计数,表9给出每个结果.
博学-面具控制臂(B.3 )只运行在六个被搁置的病人身上,在规则写成时没有结果,因此其行数都没有按照基准基线排名. • 每项结果的条件。 组合是由运行前固定的规则组装而成的:在每个槽中,作者的组件会停留,除非槽的决定发现公布的方法更低。 规则是在知道其结果和临时最低错误表的结果时制定的。 • 装有6至8个学习者种子的混合火车及其保存文物种子。 只有奖励槽改变了:SSIM的外观术语取代了REINFORCE奖励中比赛分数NCC的术语(表5:−0.047-0.047毫米[−0.085-0.085,−0.009-0.009]],5/6,霍尔姆p=0.049p=0.049,CT口罩下带有SonoSPADE帧). 这一差异位于槽后最低可探测差值(0.085毫米)以下,在3个种子中的2个种子中保持其标志,并以特制CT口罩测量。 · LPIPS也读得较低,但并非候选人,因为当规则确定时,其结果不能提供给规则。 · 没有选择测试组合的20个复制-串联CT的组件;6个被搁置的病人通知了选择。 这20起案件来自同一公共数据集(E研究所20起中的16起);这是内部复制,而不是外部有效性。 在运行时,组合只读出帧历史和目标帧,其伺服器基部只读出这些帧的学习过的口罩. • 支助 它的模仿开始,其RL阶段的行为克隆锚,它的伺服基和分机都配有真正的姿势和训练病人的CT标签,每集都通过目标窗口面保持接触平面. • 支助 随着索诺SPADE的阶段,每个帧都从CT标签切片中渲染出来,因此标签信息到达图像.

blocks.en: The combination was assembled by a rule fixed before its runs: in each slot the authors’ component stays unless the slot’s decision found a published method lower.
blocks.zh: 组合是由运行前固定的规则组装而成的:在每个槽中,作者的组件都保留,除非槽的决定发现公布的方法较低。

blocks.en: The rule was written when its outcome and that of the post hoc lowest-error table were already known.
blocks.zh: 该规则是在其结果和临时最低错误表的结果已经知道时制定的。

blocks.en: The combination trains with learner seeds 6 to 8, and its renders keep the artifact seed.
blocks.zh: 结合火车 学习者种子6到8 以及它使 保存的文物种子。

blocks.en: Only the reward slot changed: the SSIM appearance term replaced the NCC term of the match score in the REINFORCE reward (Table 5 : − 0.047 -0.047 mm [ − 0.085 -0.085 , − 0.009 -0.009 ], 5/6, Holm p = 0.049 p=0.049 , under CT masks with SonoSPADE frames).
blocks.zh: 只有奖牌档改变了:SSIM的外观术语取代了REINFORCE奖牌赛中比赛分数NCC的术语(表5:−0.047-0.047毫米[−0.085-0.085,−0.009-0.009],5/6,霍尔姆p=0.049p=0.049,CT口罩下有索诺SPADE帧).

blocks.en: That difference lies below the slot’s post hoc minimum detectable difference (0.085 mm), kept its sign in 2 of 3 seeds, and was measured under privileged CT masks.
blocks.zh: 这一差异位于槽后最低可探测差值(0.085毫米)以下,在3个种子中的2个种子中保持其标志,并以特制CT口罩测量。

blocks.en: LPIPS also reads lower but was not a candidate, because its result was not available to the rule when the rule was fixed.
blocks.zh: LPIPS也读得更低,但不是候选人,因为当规则被确定时,其结果并没有得到规则.

blocks.en: No component was chosen with the 20 replication-cohort CTs that test the combination; the six held-out patients informed the choice.
blocks.zh: 测试该组合的20个复制-加速CT没有选择任何组件;6个被搁置的病人告知了选择。

blocks.en: These 20 cases come from the same public dataset (16 of 20 from institute E); this is internal replication, not external validity.
blocks.zh: 这20起案件来自同一公共数据集(E研究所20起中的16起);这是内部复制,而不是外部有效性。

blocks.en: At run time, the combination reads only the frame history and the target frame, and its servo base only the learned masks of those frames.
blocks.zh: 在运行时,组合只读出帧历史和目标帧,其伺服器基部只读出这些帧的学习过的口罩.

blocks.en: Its imitation start, the behavior-cloning anchor of its RL phase, its servo base and its segmenters were fit with true poses and CT labels of training patients, and every episode keeps the contact plane through the target window face.
blocks.zh: 它的模仿开始,其RL阶段的行为克隆锚,它的伺服基和分机都配有真正的姿势和训练病人的CT标签,每集都通过目标窗口面保持接触平面.

blocks.en: With the SonoSPADE stage, every frame is rendered from the CT label slice, so label information reaches the image.
blocks.zh: 随着索诺SPADE的阶段,每个帧都从CT标签切片中渲染出来,因此标签信息到达图像.

blocks.en:
On 20 new CTs, the physics combination (frames not rendered from the CT label) ends at 15.62 mm [14.76, 16.48]; the authors’ original pipeline ends at 15.36 mm, its learned-mask servo base at 15.75 mm, the static start at 15.97 mm and the privileged pose oracle at 1.47 mm (exploratory).
On 20 new CTs, the physics combination gives a higher final translation error than the authors’ original pipeline (0.25 mm [ + 0.11 +0.11 , + 0.40 +0.40 ], 15/20, Holm p = 0.007 p=0.007 ; exploratory).
This difference lies within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (TOST, Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ; exploratory).
This contrast compares three trained policies per arm whose RL phases used different random streams, so it is conditional on those six RL runs (per seed + 0.02 +0.02 , + 0.32 +0.32 and + 0.42 +0.42 mm; crossed case-by-seed 95% CI [ + 0.00 +0.00 , + 0.54 +0.54 ]); on the six held-out patients, a fresh RL phase from the same imitation start under CT masks ended 0.28 mm above the policy of the primary results (Table 5 ), so a difference here is not attributed to SSIM.
Its crossed case-by-seed interval includes 0, so the difference may come from the six RL runs rather than from the change of reward.
With the paper’s score retrained with the same training procedure, masks, imitation start and seeds, the physics combination differs from that retrained score by + 0.09 +0.09 mm [ − 0.02 -0.02 , + 0.21 +0.21 ] (12/20), and the retrained score differs from the authors’ original pipeline by + 0.16 +0.16 mm [ + 0.04 +0.04 , + 0.28 +0.28 ] (estimation only).
This control holds the training procedure and the seeds fixed; it does not make a difference of the combination a property of SSIM in general.
On 20 new CTs, the physics combination and its learned-mask servo base alone are equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm ( − 0.14 -0.14 mm, 90% CI [ − 0.39 -0.39 , + 0.11 +0.11 ]; TOST, Holm p = 1.0 × 10 − 5 p=1.0\times 10^{-5} ; exploratory).
With the physics combination higher, the authors’ original pipeline is the benchmark baseline with physics frames, at 15.36 mm [14.53, 16.20], 13.90 mm [ + 13.08 +13.08 , + 14.71 +14.71 ] farther from the target than the privileged pose oracle (exploratory; the gap is estimation only).
On the same 20 CTs, our reference pipeline ends level with the scripted sweep, which reads no image (15.36 against 15.38 mm), and 0.61 mm below the static start (15.97 mm; unranked, no test).
With SonoSPADE frames, the benchmark baseline ends 1.67 mm below the sweep (no test).
Other pipelines measured on these CTs (the other learned-mask stages, the scripted sweep and the static start in Table 9 , the plug-cohort rows, which change one slot at a time and attach no decision, and the post hoc lowest of Table 10 , selected on the six held-out patients) are reported as measured, and none is ranked against it.
The estimation-only rows measured on these CTs (Supplementary S7) are likewise reported as measured, and none is ranked against the benchmark baseline.
Among them, the learned-mask S S -guarded servo ends at 14.78 mm with physics frames (Supplementary Table S7.4); specified after nearly all other results had been seen and with no decision, it is not the benchmark baseline but its next candidate (exploratory; estimation only).
On 20 new CTs, the physics combination ends 14.15 mm farther from the target than the privileged pose oracle (exploratory) (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
It meets the decision rule, with the same sign in 20/20 CTs (exact sign-flip p = 1.9 × 10 − 6 p=1.9\times 10^{-6} and Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} in family CMB-G; Table 9 ).
blocks.zh:
在20个新的CT上,物理组合(没有从CT标签中制成的框架)以15.62毫米[14.76,16.48]结束;作者的原始管道以15.36毫米结束,其学习-面具伺服器基地以15.75毫米结束,静态启动15.97毫米,特权姿势甲骨文以1.47毫米结束(勘探)。
在20个新的CT上,物理组合给出了比作者原始管道更高的最终翻译错误(0.25毫米[+0.11+0.11,+0.40+0.40],15/20,Holm p=0.007p=0.007;探索性).
这种差异位于±1\pm 1毫米(TOST,Holm p = 3.8×10−6 p=3.8\times 10×6};探索性)之内.
这种对比比较了每个臂的3个训练有素的策略,其RL阶段使用不同的随机流,因此它以这6个RL运行为条件(每个种子+0.02+0.02,+0.32+0.32和+0.42+0.42毫米;逐个种子跨越95%CI[+0.00+0.00,+0.54+0.54]]);对6个被搁置的患者来说,从CT口罩下相同的仿制开始的新鲜RL阶段结束于主结果政策(表5)的0.28毫米以上,因此这里的区别不归于SSIM.
它跨越的逐个案例间隔包括0,因此差异可能来自6个RL运行,而不是来自奖励的改变.
随着论文的分数以相同的训练程序,面具,仿真开始和种子进行再训练,物理组合与该再训练的分数不同,为+0.09 mm[−0.02 - 0.02,+0.21+0.21](12/20),再训练的分数与作者最初的输油管的分数不同,为+0.16+0.16 mm[+0.04+0.04,+0.28+0.28](仅估计).
这种控制使训练程序和种子固定;它并不改变一般SSIM的组合财产。
在20个新的CT上,光是物理组合及其学习到的mask servo碱基就等于±1\pm 1毫米(−0.14-0.14毫米,90%CI[−0.39-0.39,+0.11+0.11]];TOST,Holm p=1.0×10−5p=1.0\times 10×5};探索性.
由于物理组合较高,作者最初的管道是物理框架的基准基线,为15.36毫米[14.53,16.20],13.90毫米[+13.08+13.08,+14.71+14.71],距离目标远于特权姿势甲骨文(探索;差距只是估计)。
在同样的20个CT上,我们的参考管道水平以脚本扫描结束,它没有读取图像(15.36对15.38毫米),静态启动(15.97毫米;没有排名,没有测试)以下0.61毫米.
有了SonoSPADE帧,基准基线结束于扫射线以下1.67毫米(无测试).
在这些CT上测量到的其他管道(其他学习-任务阶段,脚本扫描和表9中的静态起始,插头-弦列,一次改变一个插槽,不附加任何决定,以及从六个被搁置的病人中选择的表10中最低的后临时排位)被报告为量测,没有任何排位。
在这些CT(补充S7)上测得的只有估计数的行同样被报告为计量数,没有任何行的排名与基准基线相同。
其中, " 学习面具S-卫士服务服 " 以14.78毫米的物理框架结束(补充表S7.4);在几乎所有其他结果都看到之后,未经决定,它不是基准基线,而是下一个候选条件(探索性;仅估计)。
在20个新的CT上,物理组合结束距离目标14.15毫米远于特权的姿势甲骨文(探索性)(在这个渲染器上的条件:网格固定的光谱,无高梁宽度,刚性组织).
它符合决定规则,在20/20 CTs(精确的标志-flip p = 1.9× 10 − 6 p=1.9\times 10^{-6}和Holm p = 3.8× 10− 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6}在家庭CMB-G;表9)中也有同样的标志.

blocks.en:
On 20 new CTs, the SonoSPADE combination (frames rendered from the CT label slice) ends at 13.70 mm [12.68, 14.73]; the authors’ original pipeline ends at 13.96 mm, its learned-mask servo base at 13.71 mm, the static start at 15.97 mm and the privileged pose oracle at 1.47 mm (exploratory).
On 20 new CTs, the SonoSPADE combination gives a lower final translation error than the authors’ original pipeline (0.26 mm [ − 0.39 -0.39 , − 0.12 -0.12 ], 16/20, Holm p = 0.002 p=0.002 ; exploratory).
This difference lies within ± 1 \pm 1 mm (TOST, Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ; exploratory).
This contrast compares three trained policies per arm whose RL phases used different random streams, so it is conditional on those six RL runs (per seed − 0.12 -0.12 , − 0.06 -0.06 and − 0.58 -0.58 mm; crossed case-by-seed 95% CI [ − 0.63 -0.63 , + 0.02 +0.02 ]); on the six held-out patients, a fresh RL phase from the same imitation start under CT masks ended 0.28 mm above the policy of the primary results (Table 5 ), so a difference here is not attributed to SSIM.
Its crossed case-by-seed interval includes 0, so the difference may come from the six RL runs rather than from the change of reward.
With the paper’s score retrained with the same training procedure, masks, imitation start and seeds, the SonoSPADE combination differs from that retrained score by + 0.04 +0.04 mm [ − 0.04 -0.04 , + 0.11 +0.11 ] (10/20), and the retrained score differs from the authors’ original pipeline by − 0.29 -0.29 mm [ − 0.43 -0.43 , − 0.16 -0.16 ] (estimation only).
This control holds the training procedure and the seeds fixed; it does not make a difference of the combination a property of SSIM in general.
Rerun unchanged on the 20 CTs, the SSIM and S S policies of Table 5 end with SSIM 0.002 mm lower, against 0.047 mm on the six held-out patients (Supplementary Table S6.7; estimation only, no test).
On 20 new CTs, the SonoSPADE combination and its learned-mask servo base alone are equivalent within ± 1 \pm 1 mm ( − 0.01 -0.01 mm, 90% CI [ − 0.08 -0.08 , + 0.07 +0.07 ]; TOST, Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} ; exploratory).
Being lower than the authors’ original pipeline, the SonoSPADE combination, at 13.70 mm [12.68, 14.73], is the benchmark baseline with frames rendered from the CT label slice (exploratory).
Other pipelines measured on these CTs (the other learned-mask stages, the scripted sweep and the static start in Table 9 , the plug-cohort rows, which change one slot at a time and attach no decision, and the post hoc lowest of Table 10 , selected on the six held-out patients) are reported as measured, and none is ranked against it.
As measured (Supplementary Table S6.7), three one-slot mask-source servo bases without privileged input end at 12.99 to 13.42 mm with SonoSPADE frames, below the benchmark baseline’s 13.70 mm (no decision, unranked). nnU-Net at 20 epochs ran seed 0 only.
The estimation-only rows measured on these CTs (Supplementary S7) are likewise reported as measured, and none is ranked against the benchmark baseline.
On 20 new CTs, the SonoSPADE combination ends 12.24 mm farther from the target than the privileged pose oracle (exploratory) (conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue).
It meets the decision rule, with the same sign in 20/20 CTs (exact sign-flip p = 1.9 × 10 − 6 p=1.9\times 10^{-6} and Holm p = 3.8 × 10 − 6 p=3.8\times 10^{-6} in family CMB-G; Table 9 ).

blocks.en: Table 9 : Combination chosen by the pre-specified rule (exploratory): the authors’ original pipeline with the SSIM appearance term in the REINFORCE reward, the only slot the rule changed. Primary: the 20 replication-cohort CTs, exact sign-flip test, Holm within families CMB-D ( m = 4 m=4 , difference), CMB-E ( m = 4 m=4 , equivalence within ± 1 \pm 1 mm, TOST) and CMB-G ( m = 2 m=2 , gap to the pose oracle, conditional on this renderer: grid-fixed speckle, no elevational beam width, rigid tissue). Each D difference compares three trained policies per arm and is conditional on those six RL runs. Other pipelines measured on these CTs print as measured and none is ranked against the combination. MDD from the observed SDs, at α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 and at Holm’s first step. The continuation prints the six held-out patients (selection-biased; estimation only), the same-procedure retraining of the match score S S (estimation only) and AMOS (secondary; estimation only).

blocks.en: Table 11 : Patient-by-seed intervals of the Table 5 rows with three seeds (exploratory). Difference and k k /6 as in Table 5 . Per seed: the difference of patient means within one seed, seed s s of the row minus seed s s of the reference, for seeds 0, 1 and 2. Seeds: those whose difference shares the sign of the mean (post hoc). Patient-by-seed: the pre-specified bootstrap, which resamples patients, then seeds within each sampled patient, with the seed index paired across arms; 10,000 resamples, seed 0. Crossed: patients and seeds resampled independently, a post hoc sensitivity check with the same resamples and seed. Rows run at seed 0 only have no seed factor and are not listed. Every contrast is conditional on the trained artifacts (texture networks, segmenters, bases and policies). † Privileged.

Appendix C Leaderboard of the plugged methods
blocks.zh: 插件方法的导板

blocks.en:
Table 1 lists every method plugged under the protocol of Section 4.2 , slot by slot, with its result in Table 5 or 1 , ordered by mean error.
As in Section 9.2 , the order is not a ranking: each method was compared only with its slot’s reference.
A later method is reported as in Section 9.2 , on the same held-out episodes as its slot’s reference.
It lies outside the pre-specified families, so it is marked post hoc, with no Holm adjustment and no pre-specified decision word.
The code repository keeps this table, in the same order, as LEADERBOARD.md , and its SUBMITTING.md describes how a later method is added.
blocks.zh:

与第9.2节一样,顺序不是排序:每种方法都只与其时间档的参考比较。
后一种方法如第9.2节所述,其时间档参考的是相同的搁置事件。
它位于预先指定的家族之外,因此是标注后的特设,没有霍尔姆调整,也没有预先指定的决定词.
代码寄存器与LEADERBOARD.md 保持了这个表格的顺序,其SUBMITING.md 描述了后期方法的添加方式.

blocks.en: Table 1 : Leaderboard of the methods plugged into each slot (exploratory). Each row is the row of Table 5 (the guide’s slots) or Table 1 (the engine’s slots) for the same method, run in its slot’s condition (slot headers, as in those tables), with 12 steps, the 60 held-out episodes of Table 4 and contact on. In each slot the reference comes first, then the rows whose difference is taken from it, by mean error, lowest first, with the privileged rows last. Rows run at seed 0 only follow the reference’s seed-0 line in the same order, since their differences are taken from that line and their error is that of one seed. The order is by mean error only and is not a ranking: each row was tested against its slot’s reference, not against the other rows, and where the decision is no detectable difference, the methods are not distinguished from the reference or from each other. The CT-anatomy rows keep the order of Table 1 , since each is scored against its own reference level. Authors’: our published component [ 5 ] . Role: the row’s group in those tables; second family: the second mask-source family or the LPIPS reward family; privileged: its group of privileged rows, which are secondary. Error, difference with its 95% paired t t CI and k k /6, and decision, with the marks L, † \dagger , ‡ \ddagger , a and e, as in those tables. The pretrained-backbone differences of Table 5 , which have no error of their own, are left out.
blocks.zh: 表1:插入每个插槽(勘探)的方法的导板。 每行是同一种方法的表5(指南的插槽)或表1(发动机的插槽)的一行,按其插槽条件运行(槽头,如这些表格),有12个步骤,表4的60个停机集和联系。 在每个槽中,引用先到,然后是取其差数的行,以平均误差,最少先到,特权行最后. 在0号种子上运行的行只按照参考的0号种子的顺序运行,因为其差异取自该线,错误为1号种子. 顺序仅以中误为主,不是排名:每行都是对照其档次的参考标准进行测试,而不是参照其他各行标准进行测试,如果决定没有可察觉的区别,方法与参考标准或相互之间没有区别. CT-anatomy各行保持表1的顺序,因为每行的得分都与自己的参考水平相对. 作者们:我们公布的部分[5]。 角色:排在那些表格中的组; 第二家族:第二口罩来源家庭或LPIPS奖励家庭; 特权:其属于第二支的特权组。 错误, 与95% 的 t t CI 和 k k k / 6 成对, 和决定, 与这些表格中的标记 L,\\ dagger,\\ ddagger, a 和 e 不同 。 表5的预训后骨差异,没有自己的错误,被忽略.
